title: A Powerful Cosmic Accelerator Has Been Confirmed in the Milky Way
content:
Scientists have identified an accelerator that produces the highest-energy protons in our galaxy, a finding that could clarify the nature of the fast-moving particles filling the space between stars.
, charged particles race through space with energies beyond the reach of even the most powerful accelerators built on Earth. Known as cosmic rays, these particles consist mainly of protons, with a smaller number of electrons. Some carry more energy than particles accelerated by the Large Hadron Collider near the border of Switzerland and France, despite that machine pushing protons close to the speed of light.
An international group led by
Hiroshima University
has now conclusively identified a Galactic source capable of accelerating cosmic ray protons to the highest energies. By combining observations from three major facilities on Earth and in space, the researchers established the nature of an object called LHAASO J1912+1014u. The result may help explain the origin and behavior of energetic particles that travel through the space between stars and affect processes across the Milky Way.
The findings were published in
Astrophysical Journal
“This immense energy makes cosmic rays important in astronomy and astrophysics,” said first and corresponding author of the study Tsunefumi Mizuno, associate professor at Hiroshima University’s Hiroshima Astrophysical Science Center. He explained that these energies are measured in electron volts — the energy an electron gains when it moves from a resting state and increases its electrical potential by one volt. “The highest energy of galactic cosmic rays can reach and exceed one quadrillion (1015) electron volts, or a peta electron volt (PeV). Finding a cosmic-ray proton accelerator above that PeV level, called a proton PeVatron, is one of the most exciting topics in modern astrophysics, and we identified one such object previously known as LHAASO J1912+1014u.”
Since 1990, the Japan- and China-led Tibet AS gamma experiment, followed by China’s Large High Altitude Air Shower Observatory (LHAASO), has detected dozens of gamma-ray sources above 0.1 PeV. Among them was LHAASO J1912+1014u.
Gamma rays are the most energetic form of electromagnetic radiation and can be produced where cosmic rays are accelerated. Their energies are typically about one-tenth those of the cosmic ray particles that created them, making sources of sub-PeV gamma rays possible PeVatron candidates. Earlier work suggested that LHAASO J1912+1014u might be a
wind nebula or another remnant of a massive stellar explosion.
“However, data from Tibet AS gamma and LHAASO experiments alone cannot clearly identify proton PeVatrons because PeV cosmic ray electrons can also produce the lower energy gamma-rays,” Mizuno said, explaining that the experiments’ image resolution is limited, so researchers cannot delve deeply enough to confirm a proton PeVatron.
Other observatories had gathered the information needed to distinguish between proton and electron acceleration. These included
’s Fermi Large Area Telescope (Fermi-LAT), whose instrument development and operation involved Hiroshima University, Japan’s FOREST Unbiased Galactic plane Imaging survey with the Nobeyama 45-meter telescope (FUGIN), and NASA’s Chandra X-ray Observatory.
LHAASO J1912+1014u was discovered in 2024 in the constellation Aquila, near Altair, one of the three stars forming the Summer Triangle. Astronomers initially regarded the object as a supernova remnant, but that interpretation changed after emissions exceeding 100 TeV were detected.
“With data from multiple experiments, we have studied LHAASO J1912+1014u in detail,” Mizuno said. He noted that the experiments provide data across a wide wavelength range from radio to gamma-rays, enabling this broad investigation with comprehensive multiwavelength modeling.
Fermi-LAT measured gamma rays with energies near one gigaelectronvolt (GeV), equal to one billion electron volts. Chandra supplied lower-energy X-ray observations, while FUGIN traced still lower-energy radio emissions. When these measurements were combined with tera-electron-volt (TeV) observations from LHAASO and other instruments, the researchers could reconstruct the source across a broad energy range and test competing explanations.
Three pieces of evidence pointed to a proton PeVatron. First, gamma-ray emission extended continuously from more than 100 trillion electron volts down to 400 million electron volts. According to Mizuno, the shape and span of this emission made an electron accelerator unlikely on energetic grounds.
Second, the GeV gamma ray map closely followed the distribution of interstellar gas measured in FUGIN radio observations. That connection is expected when high-energy protons collide with surrounding gas and generate gamma rays.
Third, Chandra detected only very weak diffuse X-ray emission. A powerful population of high-energy electrons would be expected to produce stronger X-rays, so their absence further supported proton acceleration.
“This research is achieved by team effort. There is an old Japanese saying: ‘One arrow is easy to break, but three arrows bundled together are not,’” Mizuno said. “In this study, three arrows — Fermi-LAT GeV gamma-ray data, FUGIN radio data and Chandra X-ray data — are bundled together through a detailed multiwavelength modeling, revealing that our target, LHAASO J1912+1014u, is a cosmic-ray proton PeVatron.”
Beyond identifying the object as a proton PeVatron, Mizuno emphasized that the analysis also revealed properties of the particles being accelerated, information needed to understand the source itself. Dozens of other possible proton PeVatrons remain in the Milky Way, and the researchers now plan to examine those candidates systematically.
Reference: “Hadronic Scenario for Galactic PeVatron LHAASO J1912+1014u Supported by Fermi-LAT γ-Ray Data and FUGIN CO Data” by Tsunefumi Mizuno, Hidetoshi Sano, Takeru Murase, Tomohiko Oka, Hiromasa Suzuki and Naohito Nakahara, 16 July 2026,
The Astrophysical Journal

title: Common Diet Advice About Water and Spicy Food May Be Completely Wrong
content:
Water and spice influenced eating in opposite and unexpected ways during controlled meal experiments.
A glass of water beside a meal is often treated as an easy way to eat less. The usual explanation is that the water stretches the stomach and creates a sense of fullness before too much food is consumed.
Cornell analysis
, however, found no evidence that this happened during the meals researchers observed.
Participants actually consumed about 39 additional grams of food, or roughly 49 more calories, for every extra 100 grams of water they drank. Those who alternated more often between eating and drinking also consumed more food, with each additional switch associated with another 4.4 grams eaten.
One possible explanation involves sensory-specific satiety, the gradual decline in a food’s appeal as a person continues eating it. Taking sips of water between bites may refresh the sensory contrast of the meal, allowing the food to remain enjoyable for longer and postponing the point when eating stops.
“There’s been this widespread advice that if we drink water, it fills us up,” said Paige Cunningham, assistant professor in the Division of Nutritional Sciences in the College of Human Ecology. “But water is emptied quickly from the stomach so it likely doesn’t fill us up for long. Instead, water may increase how much we eat, providing lubrication which can speed up eating, and preventing a dry mouth which can prolong enjoyment of the food.”
Cunningham served as corresponding author of the analysis, published in July in Appetite and completed with longtime collaborator John Hayes of Penn State’s Department of Food Science. A separate but related experiment examined how the heat of salsa affected the amount people ate and produced another unexpected result.
“Both studies show how mealtime behaviors and food properties can significantly influence how much we eat, without us even realizing. We found that just drinking more water was associated with greater consumption, while adding a bit more spice to a snack slowed eating and decreased how much participants ate,” said Cunningham.
For the water analysis, researchers combined data from two earlier laboratory experiments involving 86 adults. Participants received either beef chili or chicken tikka masala with water and were allowed to eat as much as they wanted while cameras recorded every bite and sip.
One finding did not fit the researchers’ expectations. People who consumed their water more quickly ate less food rather than more. The researchers do not yet have a firm explanation, noting that the pattern might involve how long water remains in the mouth or simply reflect the total duration of the meal.
“This was a secondary analysis looking at associations,” Cunningham said. “We are following up on this right now so we can make those causal inferences.”
A separate experiment, published in April in
Food Quality and Preference
, involved 49 adults who ate tortilla chips with either mild or spicy salsa once a week for two weeks. The amount of cayenne in the salsa was the only difference between the two conditions.
When the salsa was spicier, participants consumed 28% less of the snack overall. The reduction included both the salsa and the unchanged tortilla chips.
Participants also ate the spicy snack about 30% more slowly than the mild version. The researchers suspect the heat reduced intake by slowing the pace of eating. Participants drank similar amounts of water under both conditions, making increased drinking an unlikely explanation for the result.
“We were interested in whether making the salsa spicy would result in people eating the same amount of chips,” Cunningham said. “And they didn’t. The takeaway is that adding spice to one part of the snack can significantly influence how much people eat overall.”
Together, the studies complicate two familiar ideas about eating. Water consumed with meals is commonly promoted as a straightforward way to reduce intake, while spicy foods may be viewed cautiously by people trying to control how much they eat. In these laboratory settings, the opposite patterns appeared: drinking more water was associated with greater food consumption, while additional spice was associated with eating less.
“These strategies might help consumers achieve their goals to reduce energy intake,” Cunningham said.
Both studies also have clear limitations. Researchers tested only beef chili, chicken tikka masala, and one combination of tortilla chips and salsa, all under controlled laboratory conditions. They caution that different foods or everyday eating environments may not produce the same results.
“We are looking to future experiments that explore what other factors or properties of foods we can leverage to influence behaviors,” Cunningham said.

title: Common Food Additive Linked To Gut Inflammation
content:
A widely used food thickener may have more complex effects on the gut than previously recognized.
Xanthan gum helps give ice cream, yogurt, sauces, cakes, and gluten-free pasta their familiar texture. Valued for its thickening, stabilizing, and gelling properties, it is among the food industry’s most widely used additives. It also helps make liquids safer to swallow for people with dysphagia, a condition that causes difficulty swallowing.
Research from the Federal University of São Paulo (UNIFESP) in Brazil, however, raises questions about the effects of prolonged consumption. Rats that received xanthan gum for ten weeks developed colon inflammation, changes in their gut microbiota, and reduced intestinal barrier integrity. The study was supported by FAPESP.
“This isn’t about demonizing xanthan gum. Rather, it’s about emphasizing the need to invest in translational studies involving humans. It’s possible that occasional use in small amounts as an additive doesn’t harm health. The concern is with daily use as an ingredient and the cumulative effect of the thickener,” explains Alessandra Rischiteli, the nutritionist and speech-language pathologist who conducted the study. The findings were published in
Scientific and clinical interest in xanthan gum has increased partly because children and older adults with dysphagia may consume it every day, Rischiteli notes. The additive is also common in ultra-processed foods, protein shakes, and supplements. “Here, once again, the guidelines set forth in the Dietary Guidelines for the Brazilian Population – which recommend avoiding ultra-processed foods and foods high in additives – are relevant,” she says.
Xanthan gum is produced through biotechnology by fermenting material with the bacterium Xanthomonas campestris. “It’s a plant pathogen that, in nature, infects a variety of plants and can be observed when cabbage or kale, for example, begin to spoil,” she says.
Some people with dysphagia rely on thickeners to consume enough food and liquids, especially when they cannot tolerate natural options such as cornstarch. For these patients, Rischiteli says the goal should be to reduce possible harm rather than simply remove a necessary product. “Based on the results of the study, the recommendation is to monitor gut health and adopt strategies to protect the gut, such as using probiotics,” she states.
The results may help clarify earlier reports connecting xanthan gum with necrotizing enterocolitis in premature infants in the United States. This serious disease causes intestinal inflammation that can lead to tissue death.
In 2012, 22 newborns developed the condition after receiving formula thickened with xanthan gum, and at least three died. The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) subsequently prohibited its use in premature infants and advises against using it in infants more generally.
“Until then, the link between xanthan gum and the disease in infants was merely a clinical hypothesis or an empirical observation. This study on rats proved causality – that is, that xanthan gum does cause inflammation,” says Claudia Oller, a professor at UNIFESP who coordinated the study.
The researchers also examined the biological pathway through which the inflammatory response developed in the colon. “Xanthan gum is reactive and opens the intestinal barrier, altering a protein [
] that’s responsible for regulating permeability between intestinal cells, which triggers an inflammatory cascade,” Rischiteli explains.
According to the researchers, this process supports the mechanism previously proposed by American physicians to explain what may occur in the immature intestines of premature infants.
Rats fed the additive developed an inflammatory state marked by greater numbers of lymphocytes, immune defense cells, within the intestinal wall. The response was strongest among animals receiving medium and high doses of xanthan gum.
Microscopic tissue examinations found higher inflammation scores, while biochemical testing identified significant disruption of the intestinal barrier.
“This protein [
] showed higher expression in the animals’ intestinal
, indicating a loss of intestinal barrier integrity,” Rischiteli explains.
The rats also had elevated levels of the pro-inflammatory cytokines IL-1β and TNF-α, providing further evidence of an inflammatory response. “TNF-alpha, in particular, is associated with the death of cells lining the intestine [
] and the development of inflammatory diseases,” she says.
Long-term xanthan gum consumption did not significantly reduce the overall diversity of the rats’ gut microbiota. It did, however, change the balance among microbial groups.
One shift involved an increase in bacteria belonging to the phylum Elusimicrobiota, which has been associated with inflammatory conditions.
“This change indicates a state of dysbiosis, even without major alterations in the dominant bacterial groups,” she states.

title: First Sugar Ever Found in Interstellar Space Could Help Explain Life’s Origins
content:
Sugars are central to life. They help form the structural backbone of
and participate in essential metabolic reactions.
They are also thought to have been necessary for the formation of the earliest nucleic acids. Yet researchers studying life’s origins still face a major puzzle: laboratory experiments indicate that prebiotic conditions on early Earth would not have produced enough sugar.
Ribose and glucose have been found in meteorites and asteroid material, raising the possibility that some sugars formed in the ancient molecular cloud that gave rise to the Solar System. Until now, however, no sugar had been identified directly in interstellar space.
An international group led by CAB researcher Izaskun Jiménez-Serra has detected erythrulose, the first sugar identified in the interstellar medium. Erythrulose is the only possible ketose containing four carbon atoms. On Earth, it occurs naturally in raspberries and is also used in sunless tanning products.
Researchers found it toward G+0.693−0.027, a molecular cloud near the center of the
. The detection relied on highly sensitive broadband spectroscopic surveys conducted with the 40-m Yebes radio telescope and the 30-m telescope operated by the Institute for Radio Astronomy in the Millimeter Range (IRAM).
The researchers detected 12 spectral lines that matched the laboratory spectrum of erythrulose measured at the University of the Basque Country. Their analysis indicated that erythrulose is at least eight times more abundant than comparable sugars containing three carbon atoms, none of which appeared in the same cloud.
“This finding was unexpected, as the prevailing view in astrochemistry is that interstellar molecules grow in size through the sequential addition of carbon atoms,” says Izaskun Jimenez Serra (CAB), leading author of this work.
In experiments conducted with chemists from the University of Extremadura and Radboud University (the Netherlands), the CAB researchers also found that erythrulose can develop inside interstellar ice from simpler alcohols and aldehydes containing two carbon atoms.
Using the measured abundance of erythrulose in G+0.693−0.027, the researchers estimated that roughly 0.5 million to 50 million tons of the sugar may have reached Earth during the Late Heavy Bombardment, approximately 4.1 to 3.8 billion years ago. Its presence in interstellar space points to another possible supply of sugars that may have contributed to the earliest metabolic and replication processes on Earth.
“The detection of erythrulose is very exciting because it opens up the possibility of discovering in space other sugars such as ribose, which is part of RNA, and other important molecules for the origin of life,” says Carlos Briones, co-author of the study.

title: James Webb Telescope Discovers Hidden Giant Planet in Famous Star System
content:
Webb found a hidden giant planet by detecting its atmospheric chemistry through a bright debris disk.
For years, a third giant planet remained concealed within the bright dust surrounding Beta Pictoris, one of the most closely observed planetary systems in the
James Webb Space Telescope
has now exposed the hidden world by detecting molecules in its atmosphere.
The young star was already known to host Beta Pictoris b, one of the earliest exoplanets captured through direct imaging, and Beta Pictoris c. The addition of Beta Pictoris d makes Beta Pictoris only the second known system with at least three imaged planets. Unlike its two companions, the new planet was initially recognized through its atmospheric chemical signature rather than as a distinct point of light, demonstrating a potentially valuable way to find other difficult-to-see worlds.
“This discovery adds another piece to an already fascinating planetary system,” said Aidan Gibbs, lead author of a new study published in the
Astrophysical Journal Letters
and a postdoctoral researcher at the University of California, San Diego. “Beta Pictoris has long served as a laboratory for understanding how planetary systems form and evolve, and now we have another planet helping us tell that story.”
Beta Pictoris lies 63 light-years from Earth and is approximately 23 million years old. Its relative youth and proximity allow astronomers to examine how newly formed planets interact with the remaining disk of dust and debris from the system’s formation.
Researchers estimate that Beta Pictoris d has at least twice
’s mass, making it the least massive of the system’s three known giant planets. Models place its orbit about 30 astronomical units from the star, similar to
’s position in our solar system. It follows the widest orbit of the three planets but remains inside the debris disk’s inner boundary.
The researchers did not set out to find another planet. They were using Webb’s NIRSpec (Near-Infrared Spectrograph) to examine the atmosphere of Beta Pictoris b when evidence of Beta Pictoris d appeared. The observation relied on NIRSpec’s Integral Field Unit, which records an image while collecting a spectrum from every pixel.
“We weren’t looking for a new planet,” said Gibbs. “We were trying to understand one we already knew existed. Then, this telltale signal appeared in the data where we didn’t expect it.”
Where reflected light from dust should have produced a smooth spectrum, the researchers instead saw repeated peaks and dips. The pattern came from carbon monoxide absorption lines, arranged like a barcode and characteristic of the atmospheres of giant planets.
Spectroscopy can reveal both an object’s chemical makeup and its movement. By measuring radial velocity, the researchers determined that the source’s speed, location and alignment with the debris disk matched an object orbiting Beta Pictoris. The evidence did not fit a distant background star or a brown dwarf containing carbon monoxide.
“There was an unexpected bright source of light within the Integral Field Unit imaging, but we’ve learned not to trust bright blobs in images,” said Jean-Baptiste Ruffio, a research scientist at the University of California, San Diego and principal investigator of the first Webb observations where the discovery was made. “They can be instrumental artifacts or other structures in the debris disk. By obtaining a spectrum at the same time as the image, we were able to quickly confirm our suspicions.”
Follow-up observations obtained through a Director’s Discretionary Time request used Webb’s
(Mid-Infrared Instrument) to detect methane and water vapor. Those molecules provided additional confirmation that the object was a planet and revealed more about its atmosphere.
Because the planet was identified spectroscopically, astronomers could begin investigating its atmospheric properties during the same observation that revealed it.
“A spectrum contains an incredible amount of information,” Ruffio said. “You don’t just learn that something is a planet; you immediately begin learning about its temperature, chemistry, and motion.”
An independent imaging analysis led by Ben Sutlieff of the University of Edinburgh and Markus Bonse of the European Southern Observatory supported the discovery. That work used observations from the European Southern Observatory’s
Very Large Telescope
(Near-Infrared Camera) to confirm Beta Pictoris d separately.
Beta Pictoris d avoided detection for so long because it lies within one of the brightest debris disks astronomers have observed.
Dust scattered the star’s light like fog, obscuring the difference between an actual planet and features within the disk. Webb’s spectroscopic approach largely bypassed that confusion by isolating the narrow molecular signals produced by a planetary atmosphere.
The planet may also explain several unusual features of the disk, including its sharply defined inner boundary. Astronomers had previously proposed that an unseen planet resembling Beta Pictoris d could be shaping the disk into its observed structure.
The finding does more than add another planet to the Beta Pictoris system. It demonstrates a new strategy for detecting exoplanets in environments where dust or other structures interfere with conventional imaging.
Beta Pictoris d is the first directly imaged planet found primarily through moderate-resolution spectroscopy. The result shows that atmospheric fingerprints can reveal planets in visually complex systems without relying entirely on traditional coronagraphic imaging.
The researchers will continue examining Webb’s data to refine estimates of the planet’s orbit, temperature and atmospheric composition. Those measurements should provide a more complete picture of one of the best-known young planetary systems in astronomy.

title: Rare “Super-Jupiter” Discovered on an Extraordinary 180-Day Orbit
content:
Scientists discovered a rare planet larger than
orbiting a distant star once every 180 days.
A planet nearly five times as massive as Jupiter circles a distant star once every 180 days. Known as NGTS-38 b, it is an
, meaning a world that orbits a star outside our solar system.
NGTS-38 b is about eight percent wider than Jupiter and nearly five times as massive. Worlds with this combination of size and mass are commonly described as “Super-Jupiters.”
The first clue appeared in observations from
’s Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (
), which looks for slight reductions in a star’s brightness. These dimming events occur when a planet crosses in front of its star, a passage called a transit.
According to the researchers, NGTS-38 b’s 180-day orbit is among the longest ever identified through the transit method.
Toby Rodel, a PhD student in the School of Mathematics and Physics at Queen’s, led the work under the supervision of Professor Christopher Watson.
Toby comments: “This has been an incredible discovery. We’re very good at finding planets on very short orbits, close to their stars. So, finding one much further out at 180 days is a big deal!
“The journey began when the planet was first detected by TESS from just a single transit on Christmas Day 2020. Our team then pointed telescopes from the Next Generation Transit Survey (NGTS) in Chile at the star for over 200 nights, before we caught the final moments of a second transit.
“We were able to measure tiny changes in the star’s movements by splitting up the light from the star. This allowed us to detect the tiny gravitational pull of the planet on its star. Analyzing all this data together, we were able to reveal that the planet completes one orbit – which marks the length of its year – every 180 days.”
Planets traveling on long, wide orbits are especially difficult to detect because they cross their stars less often and are less likely to pass directly between the star and Earth.
Toby adds: “This planet has a much cooler temperature than most of the other planets we can study in detail, so it’s a great opportunity to study what happens to planets at these cooler temperatures.
“Most planets in our solar system have almost circular orbits, but this new planet follows a slightly more unusual and oval-shaped path. At its closest approach, it lies only slightly further from its star than Mercury is from the Sun. At its most distant, it is almost as far away as the Earth is from the Sun. However, because its host star is larger and hotter than our Sun, the planet is hotter than Earth.
“Because the planet is so massive, it also has a really strong gravitational pull and is far enough away from its star that it might be able to hold on to moons or rings, which is really exciting as we’ve never found moons or rings around any planet outside our solar system.”
The findings were published in the
Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society
. Researchers at Queen’s led the international collaboration, which also included scientists from the Universities of Leiden, Geneva, Warwick, Birmingham and New Mexico, among others.
Professor Christopher Watson adds: “This discovery was the culmination of years of detective work. Because the planet takes around six months to complete each orbit, we only had a small number of opportunities to observe another transit.”
He adds: “Pushing the capability of detecting planets at longer orbital periods is essential if we wish to find another planet like the Earth. This planet is nothing like the Earth, of course, but demonstrates how the game has moved on remarkably over the last two decades.”
A separate group led by Felipe Rojas and Dr Rafael Brahm of Universidad Adolfo Ibáñez in Santiago, Chile, independently identified the planetary system and published its own paper on arXiv.
Felipe comments: “This planet stands out among the transiting exoplanets known to date, with a mass of 4.5 Jupiters, a half-year orbit, and a mild eccentricity.
“Worlds like this have barely been explored, and their properties preserve the fingerprints of their formation, making this system a great case for studying the origin of giant planets.”

title: Researchers Warn Women About Viral Exercise Myths
content:
Women may benefit more from simple, evidence-based exercise and nutrition habits than from rigid social media advice.
Social media is filled with detailed rules telling women when to eat protein, how much water to drink, and whether exercising without food is harmful. Researchers at the University of Otago – Ōtākou Whakaihu Waka argue that most women can safely ignore much of this advice.
In a review published in
Proceedings of the Nutrition Society
, the researchers examined the evidence behind four widely shared claims involving fasted exercise, hydration, carbohydrate needs, and protein timing.
According to co-author Professor Katherine Black of the Department of Human Nutrition, most of these recommendations are not supported by strong scientific evidence.
“Women are being misled with overcomplicated messages which makes it harder for them to stay active and healthy,” she says.
“Women should be active and not worry about having to do certain things because they are a woman.”
The claims were:
Professor Black says the evidence repeatedly pointed to a more practical conclusion: a person’s individual circumstances matter more than rigid rules based on sex alone.
“Training goals, energy availability, environmental conditions and overall dietary intake exert far greater influence on performance and adaptation than any single nutrient-timing or hydration guideline,” she says.
“Nuanced and specific planning is more for the elite.”
The review also highlights a broader shortage of research focused on women’s health, exercise, and nutrition. Professor Black cautions that genuine gaps in scientific knowledge should not be filled with unsupported claims that have not undergone peer review.
For most women, she says, complicated social media guidance is unnecessary. A better starting point is to follow Ministry of Health physical activity recommendations, include resistance exercise, and eat enough of a varied diet to meet the body’s energy requirements.
“Keep it simple, do what works for you.”

title: Scientists Build the First 3D Cloak That Makes Objects Invisible To Heat
content:
A new 3D material can guide heat around complex objects while shielding them from extreme temperatures and infrared detection.
On an infrared camera, a warm object normally stands out clearly against cooler surroundings. Researchers have now built a three-dimensional cloak that bends heat around an object, erasing its thermal outline while protecting the space inside from temperature extremes.
The device is the first physical 3D thermal cloak designed to conceal complex objects from nearly every direction. Instead of stopping heat at a barrier, it redirects the flow around the hidden region and then allows it to continue along its original path. To an infrared camera watching from outside, the temperature pattern appears largely undisturbed, as though no object were present.
This approach could eventually improve heat control around microchips and sensitive electronic components. It may also help protect equipment in severe environments or reduce the thermal signatures used to locate people and machinery.
The research was carried out by University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign civil and environmental engineering professor Shelly Zhang, postdoctoral researcher Weichen Li and graduate student Yibo Wang, working with professor Ole Sigmund at the Technical University of Denmark. Their findings were published in
Nature Communications
“A real thermal cloak should work no matter where the heat comes from,” Zhang said. “Our device can hide a complex 3D object in an infinite number of directions while keeping the temperature inside stable and protected.”
Previous experimental cloaks controlled heat only across flat surfaces or along one predetermined route. If heat approached from another direction, the temperature disturbance created by the hidden object could become visible.
To move beyond that limitation, the researchers returned to transformation thermotics, a theory that calculates how heat must travel around a protected region to make the surrounding temperature field look unchanged. The idea is similar to rerouting a current around an obstacle and reconnecting it on the other side without leaving an obvious disruption.
The challenge was turning that mathematical prescription into a structure that could be manufactured. Different regions of the cloak needed carefully selected thermal conductivities, meaning they had to move heat at different rates and along different directions.
The researchers answered that problem with a lattice material whose geometry can be adjusted independently in three dimensions. Changing the shape and arrangement of the lattice allows each section to conduct heat differently. This broader range of thermal behavior brought the physical device close to the conditions predicted for an ideal cloak.
The next step was proving that the design could function as a real object rather than only as a computer simulation. The researchers combined two materials with sharply contrasting abilities to carry heat.
They printed a precise aluminum lattice in 3D to create highly conductive pathways through the cloak. Aluminum moves heat readily, allowing energy to travel quickly through selected regions. The remaining spaces were filled through mold casting with a rubbery material that transfers heat much more slowly.
Together, the materials created a controlled thermal route. Some sections accelerated heat flow while others restricted it, steering energy around the space occupied by the concealed object.
For the laboratory test, the researchers placed the cloak between hot and cold regions, producing a temperature gradient across the device. An infrared camera then recorded how heat moved through and around the structure.
The researchers then increased the difficulty by hiding intricate three-dimensional forms, including detailed shapes resembling human heads. These tests showed that the method could accommodate irregular geometries rather than only simple objects designed for controlled experiments.
The ability to guide heat around complicated forms could be useful wherever temperature must be managed with precision. In electronic systems, the cloak might redirect heat away from vulnerable components or prevent nearby heat sources from interfering with delicate devices.
It could also help protect equipment exposed to extreme temperatures. Security and defense applications are another possibility, including reducing the infrared signatures that allow thermal cameras to distinguish people or machinery from their surroundings.
“Any field that needs precise control of heat or needs to protect something from being detected thermally could benefit from this work,” Zhang said. “But we also see it more broadly: it’s about hiding and protecting information that is carried by heat.”
The current device is designed mainly to redirect heat arriving from outside. Concealing an object that produces its own heat presents a more difficult problem because that energy would continue building inside the protected region and could eventually reveal its location.
Solving this challenge would require a cloak that responds dynamically. Rather than following one fixed thermal pathway, it would need to concentrate, distribute, or redirect heat according to changing conditions inside and outside the device.
The researchers now plan to investigate smart, multifunctional cloaks capable of performing those active tasks. Such devices could eventually do more than hide a thermal signature by deliberately controlling where heat gathers, how it spreads, and where it leaves the protected region.
“We’ve shown that a true 3D omnidirectional thermal cloak is possible,” Zhang said. “The next step is to make cloaks that don’t just hide and protect, but also actively manipulate heat in useful ways.”

Nature Communications

title: Scientists Warn a Silent Oxygen Crisis Is Spreading Through Earth's Waters
content:
New research calls for aquatic deoxygenation to be recognized as a critical planetary process under threat.
Oxygen is declining across oceans, coastal waters, rivers, lakes and streams, threatening the organisms and chemical processes that depend on it. A review led by researchers at UC San Diego’s Scripps Institution of Oceanography warns that this widespread deoxygenation is moving Earth toward an “unsafe space,” with some effects potentially lasting beyond human timescales.
The researchers examined how aquatic deoxygenation, meaning the loss of dissolved oxygen from marine and freshwater environments, interacts with the nine processes included in the Planetary Boundaries framework. Introduced in 2009, the framework identifies major Earth systems and evaluates how human activity is pushing them beyond the conditions that support a stable and resilient planet.
Those nine boundaries cover climate change, ocean acidification, biodiversity loss, atmospheric aerosol loading, stratospheric ozone depletion, freshwater change, land use change, chemical pollution and biogeochemical flows (including the nitrogen cycle). The authors argue that dissolved oxygen should also be included.
“The health and stability of our planet depends on the health and stability of aquatic ecosystems, which need oxygen to function normally,” said lead author Erica Ferrer, a Scripps Oceanography alumna and current postdoctoral scholar at UC Santa Barbara’s National Center for Ecological Analysis and Synthesis. “This study is designed to elevate the profile of aquatic deoxygenation as a global threat and show that it does not operate in isolation.”
Human-caused warming, excess nutrient pollution and changes in the circulation that carries oxygen into deeper waters are the primary drivers of aquatic deoxygenation. Declining oxygen interferes with biological and chemical processes that help regulate Earth’s climate while threatening organisms ranging from microbes to fish and sharks. Marine mammals can also be affected despite breathing at the surface because oxygen loss changes their habitats, prey, and surrounding food webs.
Ferrer and senior author Lisa Levin, a biological oceanographer at Scripps, developed the idea for the review after attending COP25, the United Nations Climate Change Conference held in Madrid in 2019. They hope the work encourages researchers and policymakers to address aquatic deoxygenation together with the other pressures affecting Earth’s systems.
“Adding aquatic deoxygenation to the Planetary Boundaries framework will help us understand its impacts on Earth system stability,” said Ferrer. “Mitigating its impacts represents a critical component of maintaining biodiversity and climate.”

title: Scientists Watch Chemistry Unfold Atom by Atom
content:
Study suggests a new method for tracking electronic and vibrational dynamics in real time.
Within a few trillionths of a second after absorbing light, a molecule bends out of shape, shifts its electrons, and converts electronic energy into vibrations. These changes happen too quickly for ordinary instruments to follow, but flashes from the European XFEL allowed researchers to reconstruct the sequence
The measurements revealed that atoms within the same molecule can record different parts of a light-driven reaction. One may provide a clearer view of moving electrical charge, while another reflects how the molecular structure vibrates. The results also show that light excitation can make an atom more responsive to the motion of its neighbors.
This ability to distinguish electronic and structural changes in real time could improve investigations of fundamental processes driven by light. Possible areas of study include the mechanisms that protect
The researchers examined 3-fluoropyridine, a small molecule built around a ring of atoms. They selected it because its nitrogen and fluorine atoms could serve as separate observation points during the same reaction.
A brief ultraviolet laser pulse supplied the initial energy. After absorbing the light, the molecule entered an electronically excited state, meaning its electrons temporarily occupied a higher energy arrangement. Its normally flat structure then began to distort.
The molecule soon reached a conical intersection, a fleeting junction where two electronic energy states meet. At this point, the movements of the electrons and the atomic nuclei become closely connected, allowing the molecule to transfer between energy states rapidly.
After crossing this junction, 3-fluoropyridine returned to its ground state, its lowest electronic energy condition. The energy that had been stored electronically did not disappear. Instead, it became molecular vibration, causing the atoms to move relative to one another.
The signals from nitrogen and fluorine showed different parts of this transition. Fluorine served as a relatively clear indicator of vibrational relaxation, the process through which excess energy is redistributed through molecular motion. Nitrogen, which participated more directly in the original excitation, recorded a more complicated mixture of changing electron distribution and structural movement.
“We can now see that not every atomic site tells the same story in the signals we capture from our X-ray pulses,” says Antonio Picón from the Instituto de Ciencia de Materiales de Madrid Consejo Superior de Investigaciones Científicas (ICMM-CSIC), co-author of the study. “Some atoms report where the charge is going, while others reveal how the whole molecule vibrates.”
To follow these changes, the researchers used time-resolved X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (tr-XPS) at the Small Quantum Systems instrument (SQS) of European XFEL. The method works by removing tightly bound electrons from selected atoms and measuring the energy those electrons carry away. Changes in that energy reveal how the local chemical surroundings of each atom evolve.
First, an ultraviolet pulse excited the molecules. A soft X-ray pulse arrived after a carefully controlled delay and removed deeply bound electrons from either nitrogen or fluorine. Repeating the measurement at many delays produced a sequence of snapshots spanning only a couple of picoseconds (trillionths of seconds).
The researchers then combined these measurements with advanced simulations and models. This step was necessary to connect the shifting electron energies with the molecular changes responsible for them, allowing the researchers to reconstruct how charge and atomic motion developed over time.
The results demonstrate how the European XFEL’s brief, intense X-ray pulses can separate electronic changes from structural motion even when both unfold almost simultaneously. The measurements also show why examining several atomic sites can provide a fuller account than observing a molecule from only one location.
The approach is not limited to 3-fluoropyridine. It could be used to analyze light-induced structural changes in increasingly complex systems–from functional organic molecules to biomolecular building blocks and energy materials.
“This is what European XFEL was built to enable: watching chemical change where it begins, at specific atomic sites and on its natural timescale,” says Daniel Rivas, former instrument scientist, now guest scientist at SQS and co-author of the study. “By combining multi-site sensitivity with femtosecond resolution, we are opening a new window on the microscopic mechanisms that govern photochemistry.”

title: The Hotspot Beneath Hawaii Is Getting Hotter, Defying a Long-Held Geological Theory
content:
Rising mantle temperatures and two heat surges may explain why some Hawaiian volcanoes grew exceptionally large.
A 3500 km (2200 mile) trail of volcanoes records the Pacific plate’s slow passage over the Hawaiian hotspot. Instead of cooling through time as geologists have generally expected, the mantle plume beneath this chain appears to have warmed by about 250°C (480°F) during the past 47 million years.
The finding, led by Earth scientists at the
University of Hawai‘i at Mānoa
, challenges the long-held view that hotspots begin extremely hot and gradually lose heat. Reported in
Earth and Planetary Science Letters
, the research also links two periods of unusually high plume temperature to the formation of the largest volcanoes in the Northwestern and Main Hawaiian Island chain.
The Hawaiian Ridge contains 65 volcanoes formed as the Pacific plate moved across a hotspot fed by hot material rising from deep within Earth. Yet the amount of lava produced along the ridge varies by roughly 100-fold, leaving researchers to determine what caused such dramatic differences in volcano size.
A group led by Michael Garcia, Emeritus Professor of Earth Sciences in the UH Mānoa School of Ocean and Earth Science and Technology, examined olivine basalts from 16 volcanoes. The researchers tested four possible explanations for the changing lava volume: variations in lithosphere thickness, differences in the magma source, changes in the speed of the Pacific plate, and shifts in mantle plume temperature.
“It was a major surprise to find such a strong, direct correlation between mantle temperatures and volcano size,” said Garcia. “Other potential explanations simply failed to explain the data.”
To reconstruct temperatures deep beneath the volcanoes, the researchers developed a new “geothermometer” that estimates how hot the lava was when it originally formed in the mantle. They then compared those temperature estimates with updated measurements of volcano size derived from extensive ocean floor surveys.
Together, the two datasets allowed the researchers to trace how plume temperature and lava production changed across millions of years along the Hawaiian Ridge.
The results point to an overall rise in lava temperature interrupted by two major surges of heat. One occurred 14-20 million years ago and produced Pūhāhonu, the largest and longest-lived shield volcano formed within the past 60 million years. The second occurred 0-6 million years ago and contributed to the formation of the Hawaiian Islands.
“The development of the new geothermometer allows one to better understand the history of volcanoes and why some are larger than other volcanoes,” Garcia added.
The researchers suggest that the plume’s long-term warming may be connected to the movement of dense, hot material within the lowermost mantle.
Reference: “Taking the temperature of the Hawaiian plume using multiple geochemical approaches: Evidence for secular heating from 47 Ma to present” by Michael O. Garcia, Keith D. Putirka, Jonathan P. Tree and Brian R. Jicha, 8 June 2026,

title: “喝”甲醇“换”绿心，订单排到2030年！看江苏造双燃料大船究竟有多“燃
content:
“喝”甲醇“换”绿心，订单排到2030年！看江苏造双燃料大船究竟有多“燃_新能源资讯_新能源网
“喝”甲醇“换”绿心，订单排到2030年！看江苏造双燃料大船究竟有多“燃
7月22日早上8时，长江靖江段江水浩荡，一艘百米巨轮正缓缓驶离码头。长274米、宽45.6米——这个能装下9000个标准集装箱（TEU）、载重近12万吨的“大块头”，以甲醇为燃料，即将开启它的绿色航程。
在扬子江船业旗下的江苏新扬子造船有限公司造船基地，2026年“活力中国调研行”江苏主题采访活动的一行人，站在码头边见证这一时刻。“这条船正在进行出坞作业，接下来进行内部舾装和设备调试，预计两到三个月后出海试航，交付给丹麦的船东，未来它将满载货物，驶向全球各大港口。”扬子江船业集团副总经理周科伟指着这艘船，满怀期待地说。
庞大体量，只是感官上的第一印象；绿色内核，才是这艘船更亮眼的特点。扬子江船业集团技术中心机装科科长、9000TEU甲醇双燃料集装箱船技术负责人常松银介绍，这艘船以甲醇为燃料，燃烧时大大减少硫化物、氮氧化物等污染物，排放更清洁、更环保；螺旋桨的低噪声设计也不会对经过的海洋生物聚集地造成生态破坏。这艘船是扬子江船业为全球航运巨头马士基建造的6艘9000TEU甲醇双燃料系列船中的一艘：首制船已于今年2月交付，第二艘5月交付，第三艘6月交付——该系列船也是扬子江船业建造史上最大的甲醇燃料动力项目。
从传统燃料到甲醇双燃料，周科伟见证了“巨轮转型”的整个过程。“‘十四五’期间，中国造船业的全球市场占有率迅速提升，船用设备的国产化率越来越高，船舶制造的智能化水平逐年提升。”数据显示，扬子江船业绿色清洁能源船型订单占比已从“十三五”末的15%大幅提升至75%。
绿色动力之外，这艘船还有一项“隐形”的技术突破——全船使用有机硅涂层，这也是全球首批在新造船阶段即采用高性能有机硅防污系统的实船案例。“有机硅材料能有效减小航行阻力，还能防止海蛎子等海洋生物附着。”周科伟介绍。传统上，这类高性能涂料因施工条件严苛，极少用于新造船，但扬子江船业与涂料巨头海虹老人（Hempel）密切合作，成功在新造船上完成涂装，且未影响下水计划。这意味着船舶从出厂第一天起就具备最优水动力性能：以一艘类似规模的集装箱船为例，5年预计可节省燃油约1.17万吨、减少二氧化碳排放约3.65万吨。
绿色转型的背后，是一场更深刻的产业变革。过去，船舶燃料系统大多依赖国外厂家整体“打包”采购，企业缺乏议价空间。如今，扬子江船业通过联合设计机构将系统“拆包”，实现了独立采购单一设备、自主组装与自主调试。甲醇舱的特殊涂装、使用9镍钢或5镍钢建造的LNG（液化天然气）独立舱，企业均已具备自主设计与建造能力。从“打包”到“拆包”，一词之差，折射的是中国造船从“来料加工”向“自主配套”的跃升。
江苏造船的实力，用数据说话更为直观。2025年，江苏省造船完工量占全国份额的44.8%，占世界市场份额的25.1%；手持订单量占全国份额的39.0%，占世界市场份额的26.1%。全球船企手持订单排行30强中，江苏船企有8家入围。仅靖江一地，2025年，造船完工量就占全球总量的8.5%，手持订单量占全球总量的10.9%。“世界上每10条船，就有一条来自靖江。”
聚焦扬子江船业，最新全球造船手持订单排名显示，企业以838.3万修正总吨位列全球第四位。截至目前，集团手持订单超252艘，总价值超1500亿元，清洁能源船舶占比接近70%，交付排期延伸至2030年。2026年第一季度，公司新签22艘新船合同，总金额约9.8亿美元。
面对饱满的订单，周科伟保持着清醒：“产能扩张必须遵循国家相关政策，不能无序无限扩张。在合规前提下，企业正稳步推进产能优化，用更高端的产品回应市场的期待。”
从“喝”甲醇的绿色心脏到有机硅涂层的“滑溜外衣”，从自主可控的核心配套到排到2030年的饱满订单……江苏造船的这场绿色转型，正乘风破浪，驶向更深更远的蓝海。

title: 中国石油大学“薪火同行 碳寻未来”团队走进全国首个村级光储直柔零碳示范村
content:
中国石油大学“薪火同行 碳寻未来”团队走进全国首个村级光储直柔零碳示范村_新能源资讯_新能源网
中国石油大学“薪火同行 碳寻未来”团队走进全国首个村级光储直柔零碳示范村
近日，“薪火同行 碳寻未来”团队奔赴山西省芮城县陌南镇庄上村，实地调研全国首个整村级“光储直柔”零碳示范项目，沉浸式探访乡村能源转型样板，通过展厅研学、座谈交流、入户走访等形式开展零碳乡村主题研学，计划依托调研成果制作零碳实景科普微课。
庄上村坐落于山西南端黄河台塬，是国内乡村分布式能源转型标杆，先后斩获农业农村部与联合国开发计划署联合颁发的“中国零碳村镇示范村”、COP28“能源转型变革者”等重磅荣誉。实践伊始，团队在村内展厅聆听专题讲解，工作人员细致介绍村内2MW“光储直柔”直流微网系统，拆解光伏、储能、直流配电、柔性用电四大核心板块运行逻辑。全村71户民居及公共建筑铺设2960块光伏板，年发电量约280万度，配套717kWh村级磷酸铁锂储能站，依托低压直流配电减少电能损耗，搭配柔性用电调节平衡负荷，实现全村炊事、取暖、农机、出行全电气化，彻底告别燃煤燃油。
讲解过程中，队员们了解到项目落地后的亮眼成效：村庄年自用仅50万度电，剩余230万度余电并网供给城镇；每年节约标准煤800吨，减排二氧化碳2450吨，节水7700吨，生态减碳成效突出。在民生收益层面，村民出租屋顶光伏板每年可获固定租金，户均年增收400至1600元，冬季电采暖相较烧煤每年节省近3000元；村集体依靠余电上网年收益超90万元，同步带动黄桃特色农业、零碳文旅协同发展，走出“清洁能源增收+绿色产业振兴”双向赋能之路。
展厅参观完毕后，实践团队同村干部开展座谈交流会。队员们围绕项目落地契机、村民动员难点、光储直柔技术差异化优势、储能运维保障、收益分配机制、模式复制推广等核心问题深入交流，深度拆解乡村零碳项目建设、运营、长效发展全流程。村干部寄语青年学子，希望能源专业大学生扎根基层，深耕乡村新能源技术研发与落地，助力更多乡村实现低碳转型。
座谈结束，队员们分组入户走访当地村民，近距离倾听农户真实体验，询问电气化改造前后生活变化、光伏增收实际感受、日常供电稳定情况，收集基层群众对零碳设施优化的真实诉求。受访村民纷纷表示，电气化生活干净省心，光伏带来稳定额外收入，身为零碳示范村村民倍感自豪，乐于向亲友分享村庄绿色转型故事。
此次庄上村研学实践，让团队成员直观掌握乡村直流微网零碳技术体系，深刻理解能源转型与乡村振兴融合发展路径。下一步，团队将整理实地素材、访谈记录与项目数据，打磨零碳乡村实景微课，向大众普及农村分布式清洁能源知识，同时结合调研思考北方乡村零碳模式优化方案，以青年专业力量助力乡村绿色低碳发展。

新策略！西班牙34亿美元AI园区以现场发电跳过并网排队
这个计划中的300MW西班牙AI园区将成为欧洲最大的园区之一，开发商正寻求快速审批和现场电力策略。
西班牙中部一个拟议中的30亿欧元（34亿美元）AI园区正在推进区域许可，其能源策略反映了AI基础设施日益增长的现实：
开发商正在围绕电力约束进行主动建设，而不是被动等待电网接入
EdgeMode、BlackBerry AIF和Mora镇周一向卡斯蒂利亚-拉曼恰地区政府官员介绍了DC MALPICA AI项目，概述了建设一个300MW园区的计划，包括两座15万平方米的AI数据中心。开发商表示，他们正在准备申请将该项目指定为区域优先项目，这一地位旨在加速对具有战略重要性投资项目的许可审批。
对数据中心运营商来说，该项目最显著的特点不是其规模，而是其电力模式。
拟议中的西班牙34亿美元AI园区效果图，包括两座15万平方米的数据中心和一个创新的现场电力策略。图片来源：EdgeMode
开发商表示，该园区设计为自行发电，减少对传统电网的依赖，同时采用旨在最小化水资源消耗的技术。
公告未说明发电技术、燃料来源或现场与公用事业电力的预期组合。
Bloom Energy欧洲总监Reto Zueger与EdgeMode、BlackBerry AIF和其他项目合作伙伴的高管一起参加了会议。各公司尚未披露Bloom在该项目中的角色，Bloom Energy发言人拒绝置评。
鉴于Bloom Energy专注于固体氧化物燃料电池（SOFC）技术，该园区很可能采用燃料电池作为其主要电源。
Dell'Oro集团研究总监Alex Cordovil告诉媒体：“
电网互联已成为决定AI园区何时以及能否投运的最大单一因素，因此现场发电不再是备用计划，而是战略资产。
Cordovil表示，开发商正在设计配备专用发电的AI园区，即使计划了电网接入服务，也允许项目在电网连接延迟时继续推进，同时为未来扩展保留容量。
他举了一个例子，Nscale在挪威的AI园区，由于计划中的电网连接延迟，开发商被迫采用现场燃料电池解决方案以保持项目按计划进行。
拟议中的西班牙园区将在两个设施中提供300MW容量，专为高性能AI计算设计。
开发商估计投资为30亿欧元（34亿美元），预计建设期间创造多达5000个工作岗位，园区投运后创造约1000个永久性直接和间接职位。
Cordovil表示，该项目是法国以外目前计划中的最大AI园区之一。
他说：“一个300MW的西班牙园区确实处于欧洲目前建设的顶端。”他指出，大多数已宣布的欧洲AI园区大致在50MW到300MW之间。法国是一个例外，有几个已宣布的吉瓦级AI项目。
卡斯蒂利亚-拉曼恰负责经济发展、能源转型和电信的部门官员出席了周一的介绍会，项目正通过区域审批程序推进。
BlackBerry AIF首席执行官José Mora表示：“人工智能需要新一代基础设施，西班牙有机会成为欧洲最大的技术中心之一。”他说，该项目旨在将AI计算能力与能源独立性和可持续性相结合。
Cordovil表示，行业向大型、电力密集型AI园区的转变不太可能逆转，即使AI模型变得更高效。
他说：“我们真正在观察的是一种分化——专为AI建设的工厂正成为与通用数据中心并存的一类独特设施。”
DC MALPICA最终是否能成为这样的设施之一，取决于开发商尚未披露的细节，包括园区计划300MW中有多少来自现场发电，将使用什么燃料，以及园区将如何与西班牙电网互联。
如果这些计划能够落实，该项目将表明电力接入已成为与GPU获取同等重要的AI基础设施关键因素。

title: 江宁开发区能碳虚拟电厂完成首笔省间绿电交易
content:
江宁开发区能碳虚拟电厂完成首笔省间绿电交易_新能源资讯_新能源网
江宁开发区能碳虚拟电厂完成首笔省间绿电交易
近日，在江苏省电力交易中心鼎力支持下，江宁开发区能碳虚拟电厂积极探索绿电交易新模式新业态，以全域能碳虚拟电厂新型主体身份成功完成首笔省间绿电交易，此次交易是南京市首笔虚拟电厂新型主体参与的省间绿电交易。
本次省间绿电交易园区能碳虚拟电厂共购入青海省绿电10万度，全部用于满足园区企业绿色电力使用需求，为全市虚拟电厂发展和绿电交易模式提供了成功经验，具有三方面重要意义。
一是缓解绿电资源瓶颈。江宁区乃至南京全市由于地形、光照等自然资源禀赋不足，能够规模化开发的风电、光伏项目资源十分有限，不足以满足消费端快速增长的绿电需求。通过虚拟电厂等新型主体开展绿电外购，有助于缓解全区绿电自然资源瓶颈，满足园区企业绿电需求。
二是创新绿电“外引”模式。园区虚拟电厂坚持市场导向和创新引领，在跨省绿电交易机制上先行先试，通过省间绿电市场化交易机制，引入外省绿电，有效拓宽绿电“外引”渠道，持续为园区乃至南京市企业生产和项目落户积蓄绿电增量，打通省间绿电到终端企业需求的“最后一公里”。
三是丰富绿电交易业态。通过园区虚拟电厂开展各类绿电交易，不断拓展绿电交易的规模和范围，有助于推动虚拟电厂与其他能源形式及主体协同发展新模式、新业态，共同营造公平高效的电力市场环境，丰富绿电交易市场业态，努力为全市跨省绿电交易提供可复制、可推广的实际交易运营经验。下一步，江宁开发区能碳虚拟电厂将充分发挥资源整合、辐射带动作用，引领区域新型电力系统加快建设升级，持续探索并创新“资源聚合+交易驱动”“平台运营+能碳服务”等多元化商业模式，为全国同类型园区新型电力系统建设提供更多江宁经验。
据悉，江宁开发区能碳虚拟电厂由南京市江宁开发区管委会、华电江苏能源有限公司、南京国电南自自动化有限公司三方携手成立的江苏华电江开智慧能源有限公司建设运营，按照新型电力系统和绿色低碳发展新要求研发打造，具备“虚拟电厂+综合能源+智慧用能+电力交易+能碳管理”五大核心功能，是国内首套电碳协同的能碳虚拟电厂智慧管控平台。通过这套先进的能碳管理系统，将开发区分布式光伏、储能设备、充电桩、空调负荷、冰蓄冷系统等零散资源“集零为整”，精准解决企业绿电需求、区域新能源消纳、电网稳定平衡以及工业碳排放减排等多重难题。目前，江宁开发区能碳虚拟电厂正在加快推进市场化运营，接入了开发区内光伏、储能等多类型用户侧资源，接入资源规模超418MW，可调资源超84MW。

title: 煤基新材破局突围！昌吉抢占钠离子电池千亿产业新风口
content:
煤基新材破局突围！昌吉抢占钠离子电池千亿产业新风口_新能源资讯_新能源网
煤基新材破局突围！昌吉抢占钠离子电池千亿产业新风口
7月10日，吉木萨尔县北三台循环经济工业园区，新疆汉行科技有限公司的中试车间里，一台高温回转炉正匀速旋转，发出低沉而均匀的嗡鸣。出料口旁，几名技术人员正麻利地将刚出炉的黑色粉末取样、装袋、编号，动作有条不紊。
“中试车间已经建成，年产2000吨煤基钠电负极中试线，正全速进入调试冲刺阶段。”新疆汉行科技有限公司副总经理刘晖从出料口捏起一小撮黑色样品，在指间细细搓揉，“我们已试产出合格的煤基钠电负极产品，量产就等最后一脚油门。”
作为上海汉行科技有限公司（以下简称汉行科技）的全资子公司，新疆汉行科技有限公司承接了母公司的全部技术基因。后者是一家以钠离子电池为核心、拥有全自主研发链条和完整知识产权体系的高科技企业，总部与研发中心设在上海浦东。从上海浦东到天山脚下，近4000公里的跨越，汉行科技把钠离子电池材料产业化的关键一子，落在了吉木萨尔。
新疆汉行科技有限公司年产6万吨煤基钠离子电池负极材料和6万吨锂电池负极材料一体化基地，占地952亩，总投资52.3亿元。目前，综合楼、研发楼、分析化验楼已拔地而起，原料仓库、中试车间、三栋厂房主体已全部完工，一座现代化电池材料基地的轮廓已清晰可见。
“与头部锂电负极材料企业相比，我们的钠电负极材料成本优势约达50%。”刘晖指着中试线出料端的产品说，公司自主研发的煤基负极材料具有压实密度高、比表面积低、脱钠容量高等优秀特性，循环达到6000周时，其容量保持率仍在84%以上。目前，公司累计获得87项专利，其中23项为授权发明专利，并成为全国首批钠离子电池测评通过单位。
7月10日，在吉木萨尔县北三台循环经济工业园区，新疆汉行科技有限公司的中试车间里，工作人员正在巡检。记者巨海成 摄
这组数据放在全国电池材料行业的大盘子里看，分量不轻。
过去两年，碳酸锂价格从每吨60万元的高位骤降至7万元，锂电池产业链经历了一轮严酷洗牌。但钠离子电池的成本优势不依赖锂价涨跌——它根本不需要用锂。煤基硬碳路线更是把原料端锁死在了新疆最不缺的东西上：煤。加上钠离子电池可直接利用现有锂电生产线，仅需简单改造即可转产，其替代弹性与发展前景尤为可观。
“等风来。”刘晖的语气平静而笃定。钠离子电池的产业化窗口正在临近——储能电站、低速电动车、5G基站备用电源，这些特殊应用场景对环境、成本敏感度远高于对能量密度的苛求，恰恰是钠电的主场。钠离子电池凭借宽温域性能优异、高倍率快充、循环寿命长、热安全性高等核心特性，精准匹配矿山、港口、厂区短倒、高寒干线短途重卡的运营需求，在新能源重卡、重卡牵引车、工业叉车等多个商用车细分场景中具备明确且不可替代的长期发展潜力。
据行业预测，2030年钠离子电池市场规模将超过千亿元。而汉行科技已经提前完成了从正极材料、负极材料到电芯的全产业链布局，在新疆、山东、浙江落子三大基地，形成了“材料—电芯—应用”的完整闭环。
“风来了，有实力做好准备才能起飞。”刘晖介绍，项目全面达产后，年产值约14亿元，年利税约3.6亿元，可带动460人就业。
而在更宏大的产业版图上，这条从天山脚下延伸出去的钠电负极材料生产线，联通的将是新能源汽车、规模储能和国家“双碳”目标的星辰大海。煤，自此从传统燃料蜕变为高端碳材料——新疆的资源禀赋，由此切入了全国新能源产业链的关键一环。

title: 上海出台科技金融措施 支持可控核聚变企业登陆科创板
content:
2026-07-24 10:51 来源：上海金融
7月23日，中共上海市委金融委员会办公室、上海市发展和改革委员会等部门近日印发《上海市充分发挥直接融资功能 进一步加强科技金融服务的若干措施》。文件提出，将进一步发挥上海直接融资功能优势，强化对科技企业全生命周期的金融服务。
在核能相关前沿领域方面，《措施》明确提出，推动可控核聚变等新兴产业和未来产业领域企业在科创板上市，持续扩大科创板第五套上市标准适用范围。
根据文件安排，上海将推动科创板持续深化改革，推动出台科创板人工智能、低空经济等企业适用第五套标准上市审核指引，推动
、具身智能、大模型、量子计算、脑机接口等新兴产业和未来产业领域企业在科创板上市，持续扩大科创板第五套上市标准的适用范围，增强资本市场对前沿科技领域未盈利企业的制度包容性与适应性。用好优质科技企业试点IPO预先审阅机制，推动进一步完善上海证券交易所与优质投资机构及专业投资者的沟通交流机制。以下为具体通知及制定的若干措施：
关于印发《上海市充分发挥直接融资功能 进一步加强科技金融服务的若干措施》的通知
沪委金融办〔2026〕77 号
为进一步贯彻科技部等七部门《加快构建科技金融体制 有力支撑高水平科技自立自强的若干政策举措》精神，深化落实市政府办公厅《关于进一步促进上海股权投资行业高质量发展的若干措施》《关于进一步发挥资本市场作用促进本市科创企业高质量发展的实施意见》等部署要求，充分发挥本市直接融资功能优势，强化对科技企业全生命周期金融服务，经市政府同意，现将《上海市充分发挥直接融资功能 进一步加强科技金融服务的若干措施》印发给你们，请认真按照执行。
中共上海市委金融委员会办公室
上海市经济和信息化委员会
上海市国有资产监督管理委员会
国家金融监督管理总局上海监管局
中国证券监督管理委员会上海监管局
上海市充分发挥直接融资功能 进一步加强科技金融服务的若干措施
为深入贯彻党的二十大和二十届历次全会精神，加快高水平科技自立自强，充分发挥我市直接融资功能优势，强化对科技企业全生命周期金融服务，扎实推进上海国际金融中心和科技创新中心联动发展，现制定如下若干措施：
一、提升早期投资领投定价能力
(一)提升天使投资社会组织功能。 强化国资整合赋能，打造上海天使会升级版。率先探索形成“合格天使投资人”认定标准，推动人员落户、就医服务等方面便利化，促进天使投资人群体在沪集聚。综合运用份额转让、S基金交易、企业挂牌等多种手段建立天使投资流通机制。(市委金融办、市国资委、市人才局按职责分工)
(二)优化天使投资出资机制。 探索国有资本、社会资本等以慈善捐赠等形式对早期科创项目给予资金支持。支持产业资本投资种子基金、天使基金及早期项目，依法依规对所属产业集团给予政策支持。鼓励我市各类引导基金、母基金支持专注于硬科技、投长期的天使投资基金。(市国资委、市经信委、市规划和自然资源局、市生态环境局、市发改委、市科委、市财政局按职责分工)
(三)强化国有资金引领功能。 加快设立上海社保科创基金，遴选专业市场化投资机构组建专项子基金，打造领投定价“风向标”。支持长三角创业投资引导基金、未来产业基金等精准识别领投定价能力强的早期投资机构及团队，在子基金遴选中给予支持。我市股权投资集聚区加强综合服务，吸引优质早期投资机构及团队在沪发展集聚。鼓励早期投资机构与我市概念验证平台等开展合作对接，引导资金重点投向“中试—产业化”等关键阶段，为科技企业实现跨越式发展提供充足资金支持。(市国资委、市财政局、市委金融办、市发改委、市科委按职责分工)
(四)完善评估定价机制。 支持技术交易所、数据交易所等汇集早期科技企业的研发、专利、人才等数据，为投资机构提供便捷、高效的查询与应用服务。发挥上海未来启点社区作用，联动科学家、创业者及投资人等多方主体，为提升投资机构对前沿科技及未来产业理解与认知、强化决策判断及投资引领能力等提供支持。鼓励证券公司等专业研究队伍研究领域向一级市场延伸覆盖，提升针对早期科创项目的价值发现、估值定价能力。(市数据局、市经信委、市科委、上海证监局按职责分工)
二、构建完善股权投资接续机制
(五)构建投资接续长效机制。 加快与全国社保基金会合作设立优选项目基金，建立资本接力、协同赋能的长效机制。研究设立S母基金，引导更多S基金在沪集聚，吸引保险公司、金融资产投资公司(AIC)、金融资产管理公司(AMC)等多种主体出资设立S基金或参与份额交易。探索推动将S基金纳入嵌套层级豁免范围。(市国资委、市委金融办、市财政局、市发改委、市经信委、上海证监局、人民银行上海市分行、上海金融监管局按职责分工)
(六)提升基金份额转让平台功能。 增强上海私募股权与创业投资份额转让平台功能，打造私募股权二级市场升级版，依托大模型、区块链等完善基金份额估值体系，鼓励开展接续型、重组型等创新交易。探索将份额转让平台转让服务范围扩大至全国，吸引各类国资和市场化份额挂牌交易。支持我市政府投资基金、国资基金及其投资的企业股权通过份额转让平台退出，完善估值交易流程，提高退出效率，为规范关联交易、提升合规水平等提供助力。(市委金融办、上海证监局、市财政局、市国资委按职责分工)
(七)健全科技并购生态体系。 持续强化上市公司并购科技企业审核标准公开，支持交易双方以多元化的评估方法为基础协商确定交易作价。发挥第三方市场化服务平台功能，建设科技企业并购案例库和估值数据库。推动科技企业适用简易审核程序典型案例落地，鼓励开展第三方并购。做好国家级并购基金对接服务，发挥我市国资并购基金矩阵作用，吸引集聚市场化并购基金，围绕科技企业产业链开展并购交易。鼓励国内保险公司与海外机构开展技术合作，开发并推出本土化并购保险产品。(市委金融办、市经信委、市科委、上海证监局、上海金融监管局、上交所、市发改委、市国资委按职责分工)
(八)优化一二级市场投资接力。 做好科创板重点硬科技企业规范培育工作、境外上市沟通协调工作和创业板地方政府推送企业信息工作，市区联动做好企业合规辅导，支持我市重点科技企业对接境内外资本市场。优化面向科技企业的上市辅导体系，整合中介机构资源，提供精准的资本市场培训与对接服务。支持设立基石投资基金，并为其跨境投资提供审核备案汇兑等便利。鼓励公募基金、银行理财等资产管理机构设立更多科创主题ETF基金、科创理财产品等，培育二级市场科技投资力量。(市委金融办、市经信委、市科委、市发改委、上海证监局、上海金融监管局、上交所按职责分工)
(九)强化直接融资与间接融资联动。 支持金融机构在集团内加强“信贷+理财子公司+AIC+投行”的协同，强化“贷款+外部直投”联动。鼓励保险机构探索推出知识产权侵权责任险、研发中断险、关键研发人员意外险、产业链“链主”保险等科技保险产品。引导融资租赁机构加大力度面向科技企业提供生产、研发设备的租赁服务。加强科技企业供应链金融服务，依托航贸链推动订单、物流、仓储等关键环节信息上链与数据开放共享，为金融机构开展应收账款质押融资、订单融资等提供支持。(上海金融监管局、人民银行上海市分行、市委金融办、市经信委、市数据局按职责分工)
三、发挥资本市场关键枢纽作用
(十)推动科创板持续深化改革。 推动出台科创板人工智能、低空经济等企业适用第五套标准上市审核指引，推动可控核聚变、具身智能、大模型、量子计算、脑机接口等新兴产业和未来产业领域企业在科创板上市，持续扩大科创板第五套上市标准的适用范围，增强资本市场对前沿科技领域未盈利企业的制度包容性与适应性。用好优质科技企业试点IPO预先审阅机制，推动进一步完善上海证券交易所与优质投资机构及专业投资者的沟通交流机制。(上交所、上海证监局、市委金融办、市经信委、市科委按职责分工)
(十一)便利科技企业再融资。 用好再融资支持政策，优化再融资审核流程和再融资时间间隔，允许按照未盈利标准上市且尚未盈利的企业及存在破发情形的企业再融资，优化再融资申报材料等，支持科技企业灵活运用增发、配股、可转债等多种工具进行融资。推动再融资储架发行制度落地实施。(上海证监局、上交所、市委金融办按职责分工)
(十二)深化债券市场“科技板”建设。 推动科技创新与民营企业债券风险分担工具、国家融资担保基金等政策工具在上海落地，鼓励金融机构创设信用风险缓释工具，形成央地协同的增信体系，为科技创新债券发行提供支持。用好我市有关贴息政策，支持更多符合条件的企业发行科技创新债券。深化科技创新债券产品创新，支持更多科技企业发行科创可转债等股债关联产品。(市委金融办、市科委、人民银行上海市分行、上海证监局、上海金融监管局、市财政局、上交所按职责分工)
四、丰富多元长期资本供给
(十三)拓展金融资本来源。 探索经相关决策程序后，对优秀基金管理人设定差异化国资出资比例、门槛收益率等条件，积极吸引社保基金、保险资金等在我市出资设立股权投资基金。引导保险、养老金等长期资本扩大以“优先股+可转债”方式参与早期科技企业融资的规模。借鉴巨灾债券的风险分层设计，探索发行结构化科技金融产品。鼓励我市国资基金与AIC合作设立股权投资基金。(市委金融办、市国资委、上海证监局、上海金融监管局、市人社局、市财政局、人民银行上海市分行按职责分工)
(十四)扩大产业资本投入。 推动“链主”企业、上市公司等积极开展企业风险投资(CVC)，股权投资集聚区加大对CVC的扶持力度。依托股权投资基金快速通道等机制，提升CVC落地服务效率。鼓励CVC向产业链上下游初创企业提供“资本+技术+市场”的综合赋能。支持CVC依托母公司的产业优势与国际化布局，助力被投企业链接海外市场与融资渠道，开展战略并购与产业整合，在跨境资本流动等方面提供便利化支持。推动CVC参与全球产业投资标准制定，支持其联合海外中资企业设立跨境产业基金，构建全球科技投资网络。鼓励在沪央企设立的CVC与我市地方政府引导基金、社会资本合作，共同设立专注于填补供应链空白、攻克“卡脖子”技术的专项子基金。(市经信委、市国资委、市委金融办、市发改委、各股权投资集聚区按职责分工)
(十五)鼓励高效利用外资。 深化合格境外有限合伙人(QFLP)试点，发挥国资基金管理人的本土资源优势，推广“外资内管”模式，吸引境外优质资金。探索引入境外离岸人民币资金支持境内科技创新。对运作成熟、信誉良好的外资管理机构，推动优化设立审批流程，完善外汇资金汇兑便利，加强税务合规操作辅导。(市委金融办、人民银行上海市分行、市商务委、市市场监管局、市税务局按职责分工)
(十六)优化政府投资基金和国资基金出资要求。 根据不同定位分类设置政府投资基金管理要求，合理确定政府出资比例，推动加强资源共享和协同联动，鼓励社会资本积极参与投资，推动形成匹配产业全生命周期的基金生态链。支持创业投资类基金、国家和我市重点发展的战略性新兴产业领域投资基金适当延长存续期，积极推动创业投资类基金作为耐心资本投早、投小、投硬科技。(市财政局、市国资委、市发改委、市科委按职责分工)
(十七)完善政府投资基金和国资投资基金综合绩效评价体系。 推动建立跨周期的长效考核机制，构建涵盖经济效益与社会效益、短期回报与长期价值的综合评价框架，综合考量财务性指标和非财务性指标。有序开展政府投资基金信用信息登记和投向评价工作，科学引导社会资本投向重点领域和亟需领域，防止产能过剩和低水平重复建设。落实《市国资委监管企业私募股权投资基金考核评价及尽职免责试行办法》，推动有关企业制定尽职免责清单等细则。强化国资、财政与审计等部门的协调机制。(市财政局、市国资委、市发改委、市审计局按职责分工)
(十八)深化科技金融数智化建设。 鼓励投资机构加大金融科技应用力度，利用人工智能大模型、智能体等技术提升投研能力。探索人工智能赋能科研新范式，推动国资基金提升投资运作数智化水平，加强对投资决策、投后管理、项目退出等重点环节的监测，建立健全基金风险预警和防范机制，打造符合科技创新规律的“敏捷资本”。(市委金融办、市国资委、上海证监局按职责分工)
(十九)建设直接融资试验区。 依托我市股权投资集聚区及张江科学城、大零号湾等高能级科创集聚区，规划建设直接融资试验区。建立政策评估与反馈机制，定期梳理政策落地堵点，推动及时解决落实，总结形成可复制推广的经验做法。推动在试验区内形成资本、人才、技术、信息的高度集聚，构建覆盖从“0到1”概念验证，到“1到10”孵化加速，再到“10到100”产业放大的全链条融资服务体系。(市委金融办、市科委、市发改委、市经信委、市国资委、上海证监局按职责分工)
(二十)加强数据分析和监测预警能力。 加强对直接融资的数据分析和趋势研究，做好宣介引导工作。强化对私募基金募投管退各业务环节的跟踪研判，持续推进上海金融风险监测预警系统建设，提升风险预警能力。(市委金融办、上海证监局、人民银行上海市分行、上海金融监管局按职责分工)

title: 建成后年供汽将超3500万吨！我国“核能+化工”产业实现规模发展
content:
2026-07-24 10:53 来源：中国核电
7月21日，在中央网信办社会局、国务院国资委宣传局指导下，“习近平总书记的国企足迹”暨高质量发展中国行媒体活动走进正在建设的全球最大核能与石化产业大规模耦合示范基地。活动期间，中核集团宣布该基地一期工程建成后年供应工业蒸汽将超3500万吨，可为连云港万亿级石化产业基地大规模供应高品质低碳工业蒸汽，其成果将进一步向长三角、粤港澳工业集群复制推广，还为全球高耗能产业低碳转型提供可复制、可推广“中国方案”的全新篇章，为全球“双碳”目标实现注入强劲动力。
该基地由江苏徐圩核能供热发电厂和江苏核电“和气一号”供汽系统共同组成，主要输送目标是我国七大石化产业基地之一的连云港石化产业基地，这标志着我国核能综合利用从技术示范迈入标准化、规模化新阶段。
推进碳达峰碳中和，是我国对国际社会的庄严承诺，也是实现可持续发展的内在要求。能源结构的绿色低碳转型是实现碳达峰碳中和的关键。2025年，我国公布《碳达峰碳中和的中国行动》白皮书中指出，核电是优质高效的清洁能源，中国始终坚持在确保安全的前提下有序发展核电，推动核能在清洁供暖、工业供热、海水淡化等领域的利用。
石化和化工行业作为基础性产业，肩负着支撑国民经济发展的重要责任。对于石化产业而言，在“双碳”目标的背景下，石化产业的降碳转型势在必行。“核能+化工”瞄准的正是化工产业绿色转型中的关键需求——工业蒸汽。化工生产用汽规模大、品质要求高，生产装置又需要长周期连续稳定运行。如何在保障大规模、高品质、连续供汽的同时有效降低碳排放，成为产业转型必须破解的现实课题。
核能供汽，即利用核电站的热量供应工业蒸汽，是目前满足石化产业用汽需求，降低综合能耗和减轻环境污染的一种新途径。中核集团积极推进的“核能+石化”耦合发展，则是将核能的清洁优势与石化产业的用能需求进行了深度结合，为传统高耗能行业绿色转型提供了新思路。这不仅是一个核能项目，也是一场面向传统产业的能源供给方式变革。在连云港，中核集团将核电站与石化产业基地紧密连接，让清洁核能从电网进一步走进工业生产流程，为化工产业破解高能耗、高排放难题提供新的解决方案，也为我国工业园区和高耗能产业集群绿色低碳转型打开新的发展空间。
江苏徐圩核能供热发电厂是全球首个核能与石化大规模耦合项目、全球首个压水堆与高温气冷堆耦合项目、全球首个“堆-机-热”协调控制模式应用项目、全球首个高温气冷堆商业化应用项目。项目是以工业供热为主、兼顾电力供应的核动力厂，采用我国具有完全自主知识产权的三代核电技术华龙一号和四代核电技术高温气冷堆组合，通过华龙一号主蒸汽加热除盐水制备饱和蒸汽，再利用高温气冷堆主蒸汽对饱和蒸汽二次升温，产生三种不同参数的高品质工业蒸汽，满足石化园区工业用汽需求，建成后设计工况下将同时具备高品质蒸汽供应能力和发电能力。项目一期工程规划建设2台华龙一号机组与1台高温气冷堆机组。项目开展70余项课题研究，已落地应用40余项科技创新成果 ，首创双母管连续供热、小温差大型换热、堆机热一体化智能调控 等成套技术，同步攻克海下盾构、模块化建造 等施工难题，多项创新填补全球核能工业供热技术空白。
“和气一号”项目以江苏核电3、4号机组二回路中的蒸汽作为热源，采用多级换热技术，通过工业蒸汽管网，将压力为1.8兆帕、温度为248摄氏度的蒸汽，经由独立隔离回路输送至23.36公里外的连云港石化产业基地。该项目是国际上首次针对压水堆核电机组大规模生产供应工业蒸汽开展的探索实践，既无标准规范可循，也无工程实例参考。其重要创新点在于实现了堆芯功率、供汽热功率及电网功率的实时精准匹配。通过研发大型供汽机组的堆机热匹配技术，成功解决了供汽设备故障导致工业蒸汽流量突发大幅下降时，堆功率自动响应速度慢的问题。“和气一号”还创新采用了国内单套容量最大的双侧相变式蒸汽转换技术，实现冷热介质的逆向对流换热，将核电站热效率提升至42% ，为核能供汽供热提供了更高效、更稳定的技术支撑。截至目前，“和气一号”已为连云港石化基地供给绿色蒸汽超480万吨 ，为石化产业的发展注入了强劲的绿色动能。
不仅如此，中核集团建立了我国首个核能工业供汽碳足迹因子测算体系，相当于给每千克核能蒸汽都办了一张绿色身份证，精准计算出它从海水变工业蒸汽全生命周期、全生产流程的碳排放，填补国内外行业空白，有助于提升中国产品绿色竞争力;按照国内国际产品碳足迹量化标准进行测算的数据显示，核能供汽碳足迹是燃煤热电联产蒸汽的1/600 ，是天然气热电联产蒸汽的1/100 ;核能供汽比核电减排效果更显著，比化工蒸汽低碳优势更突出，比天然气和氢气更绿色。
一直以来，中核集团坚持以习近平生态文明思想为指导，牢固树立绿色发展理念，持续发挥清洁能源主力军作用。旗下上市公司中国核电已拥有控股在运核电机组27台 ，控股在建及核准待建机组18台 ，总装机容量4685.9万千瓦 ，2025年全年度累计清洁能源上网电量2307.47亿千瓦时 ，为实现“双碳”目标提供稳定可靠支撑。
近年来，中核集团持续拓展“核能+”多元应用场景，在“核能+供暖”“核能+医疗”“核能+算力” 等领域加快布局。“核能+化工” 的落地，进一步拓展了核能应用的产业边界，展现了核能赋能千行百业、培育新质生产力的广阔空间。

title: 生态环境部华东核与辐射安全监督站赴三澳核电基地开展核安全文化主题宣贯

在交流发言环节，各参会单位代表纷纷表示，本次宣贯活动内容丰富、案例详实。核安全文化绝非悬挂于墙上的标语口号，而是凝聚在每一颗螺栓、每一道焊缝中的实际行动。在后续工作中将坚持“遇事多存一份质疑，操作多看一点程序”，坚决摒弃经验主义、杜绝侥幸心理，将核安全文化深度融入日常作业各环节、全流程，切实提升现场核安全管控水平。

title: 生态环境部核与辐射安全中心召开2026年年中工作总结会

title: 苏州智材获出口许可向美国客户交付首批ReBCO高温超导靶材
content:
2026-07-24 10:26 来源：苏州智材
近日，苏州工业园区企业苏州智材科技有限公司(以下简称“苏州智材”)取得中国政府出口许可，向美国客户交付首批稀土钡铜氧(ReBCO)高温超导靶材。此次交付是双方一揽子供货合同的一部分，也标志着我国ReBCO靶材实现首次出口。
ReBCO靶材是采用脉冲激光沉积(PLD)工艺制备第二代高温超导带材的核心耗材。长期以来，全球ReBCO靶材供应高度集中，下游高温超导和可控核聚变领域面临较高供应链风险。近年来，受可控核聚变等应用需求带动，全球第二代高温超导带材生产商加快扩产，新进入者持续增加，对ReBCO靶材的采购和定制化需求同步上升。
苏州智材方面表示，公司历时数年完成相关技术攻关，已形成ReBCO靶材完整解决方案。此次向美国客户供货，意味着公司开始进入全球可控核聚变及高温超导领域核心供应链。
与ReBCO靶材同步获批出口并完成交付的，还包括用于第二代高温超导带材缓冲层帽层制备的LSMO靶材。该材料主要用于缓解MgO层与ReBCO超导层之间的晶格失配，并传递下层双轴织构，为ReBCO超导层高质量外延生长提供连续、平整、无裂纹、致密且高温化学稳定的模板表面。据介绍，苏州智材LSMO靶材密度达到96.4%，接近客户在用的全球头部靶材厂商97%的水平。
此外，苏州智材另一款定制组分ReBCO超导靶材正在商务部审核中，待取得两用物项出口许可后，将继续交付美国客户。
苏州智材位于苏州工业园区，是一家新材料研发与生产企业，团队具备氧化物靶材研发、量产和商业化经验。公司表示，随着ReBCO超导靶材量产线后续建成投产，国内第二代高温超导靶材供应能力有望进一步提升。

title: 首台P320国产化改造完成
content:

近日，红沿河核电4号机组并网后，顺利完成一次调频功能及调速系统建模试验，各项参数稳定达标、性能表现优异，标志着红沿河首台P320(汽轮机调节与保护控制系统)国产化改造项目圆满收官。
汽轮机调节控制系统，是核电汽轮机组运行调控的核心大脑与神经中枢，核心技术过去长期由国外垄断。核心算法封闭、技术逻辑不透明，叠加备件停产、外方服务滞后、运维成本居高不下等情况，成为制约机组高效运维的“痛点”。
为彻底破除技术依赖、筑牢设备自主可控根基，红沿河公司工程改造部牵头成立专项组，全面启动P320国产化改造。项目团队逐项拆解技术难点，对硬件架构、软件逻辑、控制算法、联锁保护开展全维度分析校核，历经数次仿真推演、集成验证、功能调试，成功攻克核心技术难题。改造后，系统在机组转速控制精度、一次调频响应效率等关键性能上，全面优于原进口系统。
依托首台机组改造完整实践经验，项目团队系统梳理全流程管控要点，建立了覆盖方案策划、设备管控、施工实施、调试验证、风险防控、验收鉴定的全生命周期标准化体系，累计形成29份施工程序、预案及技术规范，打造了可复制的P320国产化改造方案。

title: ITER上部电子回旋加热发射器通过设计评审
content:
国际热核聚变实验堆 (ITER) 电子回旋加热 (ECH) 系统的上部发射器项目近期通过设计评审，相关团队将转入正式生产准备阶段。该系统位于ITER加热与电流驱动装置前端，用于将高功率微波束注入等离子体，以辅助等离子体加热和稳定控制。
电子回旋加热系统的微波由安装在邻近建筑内的电源和回旋管产生，随后经波导传输至反应堆，并由发射器精确注入等离子体。欧洲方面负责建造4台上部发射器，这些设备将安装在ITER真空容器上半部。每台发射器长约6米，最高可传输8兆瓦功率，相当于约8000台家用微波炉的功率。
上部发射器的工作方式类似潜望镜，通过内部镜面系统调整微波束路径，将能量导向等离子体中的指定区域。其作用不仅是提供加热功率，还包括帮助抑制可能影响等离子体稳定运行的局部扰动。
2022年，欧洲聚变能源组织 (Fusion for Energy, F4E) 与IDOM-ALSYMEX联合体签署合同，负责交付4台上部发射器和5套真空容器外波导。其中，第5套波导将用于连接由日本方面承担的发射器。该项目并非从概念阶段直接启动制造，F4E和ITER组织 (ITER Organization, IO) 已就工程方案开展多年优化，并吸收了瑞士等离子体中心 (Swiss Plasma Center, SPC)、意大利国家研究委员会 (CNR)、卡尔斯鲁厄理工学院 (KIT)、荷兰基础能源研究所 (DIFFER) 以及马克斯·普朗克等离子体物理研究所 (IPP) 等机构在电子回旋共振物理和相关技术方面的经验。
对供应商而言，项目难点在于将高要求的工程设计转化为可稳定制造的工业产品。团队围绕结构、热负荷、微波传输、远程维护和制造可行性开展了多轮分析、试验和原型验证。F4E项目经理桑德拉·朱利亚表示，项目能够推进到当前阶段，依靠的是ITER、F4E、工业界和实验室专家之间的持续协作，团队已从蓝图设计逐步进入实际工程实施阶段。
上部发射器的设计还需要适应ITER内部强辐射和高温环境，并集成冷却与屏蔽功能。为提前验证方案，项目团队建造了发射器光路的全尺寸模型，并在SPC的FALCON测试平台和IPP的MISTRAL装置上开展射频测试。这些平台可用于模拟ITER运行条件下的关键工况。
IDOM项目经理伊尼戈·埃莱奇格拉表示，大量鉴定与验证工作为设计方案提供了支撑，也增强了项目继续推进的信心。ITER组织电子回旋加热项目负责人娜塔莉娅·卡萨尔表示，此次通过评审是多年技术工作的阶段性成果，团队已逐步解决设计、集成和可制造性方面的主要问题。
目前，项目团队还在最终完善波导设计。波导同样是ITER电子回旋加热系统的重要部件，后续也将进入生产准备阶段。

title: 九州电力完成玄海核电站海啸影响再评估
content:
九州电力株式会社 (Kyushu Electric Power Co., Inc.) 7月24日表示，已根据日本地震调查研究推进本部 (Headquarters for Earthquake Research Promotion) 发布的长期评估结果，对玄海核电站可能受到的海啸影响进行了重新评估。
此次评估源于日本地震调查研究推进本部于2022年3月公布的日本海西南部海域活动断层长期评估。该评估范围涉及九州地区及中国地区西北部海域。九州电力称，公司基于“核安全提升没有终点”的认识，持续收集、分析并反映有助于提升安全性的新知识和新信息。
根据九州电力公布的结果，在玄海核电站厂区内各评估点，场地标高均高于预计到达的海啸高度。日本原子力规制委员会 (NRA) 的审查也确认，相关海啸影响不会对电站安全性造成影响。
具体来看，在3、4号机组取水坑前方这一靠近海域且设有重要设备的主要区域，场地标高为11米，评估海啸高度为7米;在厂区西北侧前端区域，评估海啸高度最高，为14米，对应场地标高为16米。其他评估点中，1、2号机组取水口侧和放水口侧雨水排水通道的海啸高度均为6.5米，3、4号机组放水口侧雨水排水通道的海啸高度为5.5米，相关区域场地标高均为11米。
九州电力表示，为更严格评估海啸影响，本次分析采用了比地震调查研究推进本部公布断层更长的假定断层，并据此模拟较大海啸的产生及其向核电站厂区上溯的情况。评估过程中还考虑了厂区岸壁和海底地形等条件，重点核查了反应堆安全壳、乏燃料池、柴油发电机等重要设备所在区域的海啸高度。

title: 亚美尼亚政府批准核电站二号机组延寿计划进展报告
content:
7月23日，亚美尼亚政府批准了亚美尼亚核电站二号机组多次延长运行寿命计划的实施进展报告。该计划目标是进一步提升机组安全水平，并确保其运行至2036年。
亚美尼亚核电站位于梅察莫尔镇附近，距离首都埃里温以西约30公里，是南高加索地区唯一在运核电站，也是亚美尼亚主要电力来源之一，发电量约占该国总发电量的40%。
根据相关文件，该延寿和现代化改造计划共包含103项措施，重点包括机组安全评估与提升、应急和消防系统升级、设备检查、已发现不符合项整改，以及概率安全分析等。部分研究和评估报告已提交亚美尼亚核安全监管委员会审查。
项目工作于2020年启动，并于2023年获得亚美尼亚政府和核安全监管委员会批准。此前披露的信息显示，该计划总拨款为1.6亿美元。2023年12月，亚美尼亚方面与俄罗斯原子能服务公司 (Rusatom Service) 签署了一份价值约5750万美元的框架协议。
在103项措施中，俄罗斯原子能服务公司负责23项主要工作。目前，18项已签署合同，其中9项正在执行，9项已经完成;另有5项正在编制技术规范。亚美尼亚核电站封闭式股份公司 (Armenian Nuclear Power Plant CJSC) 负责37项主要工作。为推进相关措施，已开展45项采购程序，授予36份合同，其中17份合同项下工作已经完成，另有合同仍在签署或招标阶段。部分项目因相关前置工作尚未完成而推迟实施。
2023年9月，亚美尼亚政府批准了二号机组延寿和现代化改造计划，目标运行期限延至2036年。2026年7月9日，亚美尼亚政府又批准向亚美尼亚核电站提供201亿德拉姆预算贷款，用于推进相关工作。此前，在2020年至2025年期间，该电站已获得632亿德拉姆预算贷款，用于实施二号机组延寿和现代化改造第一阶段计划，该阶段将持续至2026年。
亚美尼亚当局还计划在未来8至10年内建设一座新核电站，目前正研究不同技术方案，并参考美国、法国、中国、俄罗斯和韩国等国相关企业和机构的经验。俄罗斯国家原子能公司 (Rosatom) 已向亚美尼亚方面提交一份建设1200兆瓦新机组的初步可行性研究报告。此前，俄罗斯国家原子能公司方面表示，可向亚美尼亚提供单机容量从50兆瓦到1000兆瓦不等的核反应堆方案。

title: 俄罗斯即将启动远东地区核电站配套风电项目建设
content:
俄罗斯国家原子能公司(Rosatom)近日宣布，计划在俄罗斯远东地区建设的400兆瓦风电项目将于2026年底进入主体工程建设阶段。该项目是滨海边疆区核电站(Primorskaya NPP)建设计划的配套内容之一，旨在缓解远东地区长期存在的电力供应紧张问题。
按照规划，这座风电场将采取分阶段并网方式，预计于2027年至2029年陆续投入运行。其建设进度将与滨海边疆区核电站形成衔接。后者计划于2030年初投运，总装机容量约2吉瓦。
Rosatom总裁阿列克谢·利哈乔夫(Alexey Likhachev)表示，风电项目投资和建设周期通常为1至2年，可在较短时间内形成新增电力供应，为大型核电项目建设提供时间窗口。按照这一安排，当地将先通过风电补充电力缺口，再由核电项目承担长期稳定供电任务。
该风电项目由Rosatom旗下风电业务主体俄罗斯国家原子能可再生能源公司(Rosatom Renewable Energy)负责实施。该公司曾使用“NovaWind”名称，目前在俄罗斯境内的风电项目组合规模已超过2吉瓦，其中约1.3吉瓦已投入运行。

title: 俄越推进宁顺1号核电站合作 人才培养成为核工业合作重点
content:
俄罗斯国家原子能公司 (Rosatom) 驻越南代表处主任德米特里·拉斯波平 (Dmitry Raspopin) 近日表示，专业人才培养是俄罗斯与越南核工业合作的基础。2017年至2025年，共有400名越南学生在俄罗斯高校学习，其中包括俄罗斯国家原子能公司体系内的重点院校，如俄罗斯国立核能研究大学莫斯科工程物理学院 (MEPhI)、圣彼得堡彼得大帝理工大学和托木斯克理工大学。其中约30人接受了与核工业直接相关的专业培训。
拉斯波平表示，核能项目周期长、专业要求高，如果没有持续的人才培养，相关项目很难顺利实施。根据俄越双方通过的《2030年前和平利用核能合作路线图》，两国计划在核电站建设、核科学和核医学中心建设，以及越南专业人才赴俄罗斯高校培养等方面扩大合作。
俄越在核能领域的合作已有较长历史。拉斯波平介绍，两国自上世纪五六十年代起便在核能相关领域保持合作，全面合作则始于上世纪八十年代。当时，苏联核科学家参与了越南大叻研究堆的现代化改造。目前，大叻研究堆功率约为500千瓦。俄罗斯还向越南供应核燃料，最近一次供应于去年11月由俄罗斯国家原子能公司旗下燃料公司TVEL完成。
大叻研究堆目前对越南核医学应用具有重要意义。据俄罗斯国家原子能公司方面介绍，该研究堆为越南市场供应约80%的放射性药物，为越南在癌症诊断和治疗领域保持相关能力提供支撑。
在核电建设方面，宁顺1号核电站是俄越核能合作的重要项目。该项目曾在2010年代启动合作，后因越方决定调整而暂停。2024年12月，越南国会决定重启宁顺1号核电站项目。随后，双方围绕项目建设重新展开工作，并于2026年3月23日在莫斯科签署关于宁顺1号核电站建设的政府间协议，明确项目将采用俄罗斯先进技术，并利用俄罗斯提供的专项贷款推进建设。
拉斯波平表示，宁顺1号核电站项目运营寿命约为60年至80年，建设期约10年，退役期约10年。按全寿期计算，该项目持续时间可达约100年，将为多代人提供长期就业和产业发展机会。
宁顺1号核电站拟采用第三代增强型VVER-1200反应堆作为参考技术。拉斯波平介绍，这一技术并非未经工程验证的新方案，目前俄罗斯和白俄罗斯已有6台VVER机组投入运行，埃及、匈牙利、中国和孟加拉国也在建设同类机组。
他表示，VVER-1200反应堆的主要特点是同时配置主动安全系统和被动安全系统，以保障反应性控制、余热排出和放射性物质包容等基本安全功能。主动安全系统依靠电力和泵组运行，响应速度较快;被动安全系统在事故条件下无需外部电源、泵组或操作人员干预，可维持反应堆安全状态。
该堆型还配备堆芯捕集器，可在严重事故条件下通过化学作用冷却并固化堆芯熔融物，降低放射性物质释放风险。双层安全壳则为反应堆提供物理屏障，内层由约一米厚的预应力混凝土和密封钢衬里构成，外层钢筋混凝土结构可抵御飓风、地震和海啸等外部事件。拉斯波平表示，考虑到越南核电项目选址靠近海洋，这一安全设计具有重要意义。

title: 国际会议聚焦放射性废物最终隔离与核遗留设施治理
content:
2026年7月21日至23日，以“放射性废物的最终隔离——核能安全和可持续发展的关键要素”为主题的国际会议在哈萨克斯坦库尔恰托夫举行。会议围绕放射性废物管理、乏核燃料处置、核遗留设施治理等议题展开交流。
来自亚美尼亚、白俄罗斯、哈萨克斯坦、吉尔吉斯斯坦、俄罗斯、塔吉克斯坦和乌兹别克斯坦的代表，以及独立国家联合体执行委员会、俄罗斯核燃料公司 (TVEL) 的代表出席会议。TVEL是独联体成员国在乏核燃料、放射性废物管理，以及核与辐射危险设施退役领域的基础组织。
会议期间，与会代表听取了俄罗斯国家原子能公司 (Rosatom) 旗下相关核心机构近五年来的工作情况介绍。2026年4月3日，独联体经济理事会批准《独联体成员国2030年前放射性废物和乏核燃料管理主要合作领域》文件，该文件由TVEL直接参与制定。独联体成员国议会间大会此前还通过了《放射性废物管理示范法》。
核遗留设施治理是本次会议的重点议题之一。会议介绍了独联体成员国在消除核遗留设施相关辐射和环境威胁方面开展合作的概念草案。该草案拟建立核遗留设施登记册，对相关设施进行排序评估，并制定降低环境影响的机制。
会议的一项重要成果，是在哈萨克斯坦国家核中心成立放射性废物管理区域能力委员会。该委员会将推动独联体成员国在放射性废物管理方面加强协调，支持建立可持续的国家废物管理体系，并推进铀矿遗留场地修复工作。
成立该委员会的倡议由哈萨克斯坦提出，并已在2026年6月10日于阿拉木图举行的独联体和平利用原子能委员会第27次会议上进行讨论。与会各方认为，相关国家间合作将有助于提升独联体范围内的核安全与辐射安全水平。

title: 意大利Sòphia HT推出核聚变装置维护机械臂ROMAN
content:
意大利航空航天和国防工程制造企业索菲亚高科技有限公司 (Sòphia High Tech Srl，Sòphia HT) 7月23日宣布推出ROMAN机械臂。该设备面向核聚变装置内部检查和维护场景，可在人类难以进入、运行条件严苛的环境中开展远程作业。
据介绍，ROMAN机械臂由索菲亚高科技与那不勒斯费德里科二世大学工业工程系 (Department of Industrial Engineering，DII)、赫罗机器人公司 (Herobots) 合作完成，相关系统已为DII和RFX联合体 (Consorzio RFX) 进行设计、开发、生产、组装、测试和集成。
ROMAN系统主要服务于RFX-mod2核聚变研究装置。该装置运行时等离子体温度可达约2000万摄氏度，内部检查和维护对设备可靠性、定位精度和远程操作能力提出较高要求。ROMAN机械臂可对装置最内壁进行远程检测和维护，其定制工具能够识别、拆卸和重新安装单块石墨瓦片，并执行目视检查和清洁作业。
在项目分工中，索菲亚高科技主导了ROMAN机械臂的开发、制造、组装、测试和集成，并与DII、赫罗机器人公司及RFX联合体共同完成方案定义、验证和优化。赫罗机器人公司专注于安全关键应用中的机器人和自动化技术，DII则提供复杂和危险环境下机器人系统相关技术支持。
索菲亚高科技表示，ROMAN项目将公司在火箭、卫星和防务系统关键部件方面积累的精密工程能力，延伸至核技术和能源基础设施领域。该公司首席技术官多梅尼科·博雷利 (Domenico Borrelli) 称，开发能够在RFX-mod2内部安全、重复运行的机械臂，需要定制机械结构、专用末端执行器以及大量验证工作。
索菲亚高科技目前由杰能塔科学股份公司 (Genenta Science SpA) 支持。杰能塔科学正计划更名为赛恩特拉锻造股份公司 (Saentra Forge SpA)，该事项仍需获得股东批准。资料显示，杰能塔科学持有索菲亚高科技19%股权，并拥有按预先约定估值将持股比例提高至51%的选择权。

title: 斯摩棱斯克核电站1号机组提前完成大修并恢复满功率运行
content:
7月23日，俄罗斯斯摩棱斯克核电站1号机组在完成计划性大修后恢复至100%功率运行。该轮大修于5月9日启动，较原计划提前3天完成，相关工作按安全和质量要求实施。
斯摩棱斯克核电站隶属于俄罗斯核电站运营公司(Rosenergoatom)，该公司为俄罗斯国家原子能公司(Rosatom)电力部门下属企业。此次大修期间，现场人员完成了主设备和辅助设备的大量检修及现代化改造工作，以维持1号机组的安全水平和运行可靠性。
在反应堆厂房内，本次检修的重点之一是实施反应堆堆芯资源特性管理第四阶段工作。该项工作用于延长RBMK-1000机组石墨砌体的服役寿期。检修人员借助机器人设备和专用工装，恢复了195个工艺通道栅格单元的资源状态，并更换了26根控制与保护系统通道。
汽轮机厂房内，机组电气部分完成了一项关键改造：更换1号汽轮发电机定子。该定子重量超过230吨，安装过程中采用两台桥式起重机协同吊装，对起重作业和工程技术配合提出了较高要求。
此外，检修团队还对1号、2号汽轮发电机组的高压缸和低压缸实施大修，并对再热系统脉冲安全阀进行现代化改造，以提升设备热效率和保护可靠性。围绕机组寿期延长计划，现场还完成了多重强制循环回路DN800阀门检修、主循环泵检修及可拆部件更换，并开展了金属材料和焊缝的运行检查。
斯摩棱斯克核电站方面表示，1号机组提前并网增加了有效发电时间，额外发电量超过5000万千瓦时。今年上半年，该核电站通过优化检修安排，累计增加发电量1.13亿千瓦时。
此次参与1号机组检修的人员超过1000人，来自斯摩棱斯克核电站、Atomenergoremont、Smolenskenergoremont、Prolog等单位及承包机构。斯摩棱斯克核电站目前运行3台机组，单机电功率均为1000兆瓦。

title: 斯摩棱斯克核电站二期建设现场完成首次消防安全审查
content:
Rosenergoatom
俄罗斯原子能电力公司 (Rosenergoatom) 委员会近日对斯摩棱斯克核电站二期建设现场开展消防安全专项检查。这是该在建场址首次接受此类审查，属于核电建设项目计划性安全监测的一部分，重点评估施工阶段消防安全措施落实情况。
审查期间，委员会检查了现场消防安全管理、移动式建筑使用要求、施工巡查机制以及承包单位协同情况。Rosenergoatom消防安全部门有关负责人马克西姆·阿尔达舍夫 (Maxim Ardashev) 表示，业主方已制定移动式建筑消防安全要求提示文件，并安排与施工现场相关单位联合开展日常检查;现场建设管理单位、核电站消防安全部门和总承包商泰坦-2控股公司 (TITAN-2) 已建立定期沟通机制，对发现的问题及时制定整改措施。
委员会将近期重点工作指向场区消防基础设施建设，尤其是室外消防给水管网施工。相关工作将按区段推进，并设置进度控制节点，把水压试验、安装阶段与施工计划相衔接，以便消防系统随各区域施工进展逐步投用。
斯摩棱斯克核电站二期项目方面表示，外部专家审查有助于对照行业实践优化现场安全管理。项目后续将随着施工规模扩大，继续调整消防安全重点，保障2027年3月反应堆厂房基础底板开始浇筑这一关键节点。
按照Rosenergoatom的做法，对在建核电项目的类似现场检查每年开展两次，以便根据人员规模、作业种类和现场条件变化，及时修订防护措施。
目前，斯摩棱斯克核电站二期施工安装基地正在建设为2027年3月进入主体施工阶段所需的配套设施。纤维模板生产车间、惰性材料仓库、实验室和生活楼等混凝土砂浆设施的基础已完成浇筑;钢筋加工设施正在进行基础施工和金属结构安装。场内道路、围栏、照明、消防给水管网等基础设施也列入近期建设计划。项目预计于8月至9月接收110/10千伏变电站部分设备，包括配电装置、通信系统和自动化系统。

title: 日本核燃料公司六所铀浓缩厂贫化铀储存能力扩建计划获地方预先批准
content:
7月24日，日本核燃料公司 (Japan Nuclear Fuel Limited, JNFL) 表示，已依据相关安全协议，向青森县和六所村提交六所铀浓缩厂建设及扩建计划，并获得地方预先批准。公司称，待各项准备工作完成后，将向日本原子力规制委员会 (NRA) 提交经营变更许可申请。
根据随附资料，本次变更主要涉及六所铀浓缩厂贫化铀最大储存能力提升。六所铀浓缩厂采用离心分离法，将天然铀分离为浓缩铀和贫化铀，其中浓缩铀用于生产商用轻水堆燃料原料。生产过程中产生的贫化铀装入48Y钢瓶后，储存在铀储存及废弃物厂房的B铀储存室和C铀储存室内。日本核燃料称，贫化铀未来可考虑作为混合氧化物燃料 (MOX) 原料等用途。
资料显示，该厂现有贫化铀最大储存能力为1222只48Y钢瓶，预计将在2028年12月达到上限。为增加储存余量，日本原燃计划将B铀储存室内部分单层堆放支架改为双层堆放支架，并在C铀储存室空余区域增设双层堆放支架。变更完成后，贫化铀最大储存能力将增加362只48Y钢瓶，达到1584只。其中，B铀储存室储存能力将由592只增至792只，C铀储存室将由630只增至792只。
日本核燃料在安全性说明中称，新增支架将采用与现有双层堆放支架相同的规格和结构。贫化铀以密封状态储存在48Y钢瓶内，储存能力提升不会增加通过排气或排水向设施外释放的放射性物质量。对设施直接辐射和天空散射辐射造成的公众剂量评估结果约为0.02毫希沃特/年，低于周边监测区域外1毫希沃特/年的剂量限值，也低于50微希沃特/年的剂量目标值。
资料还显示，本次变更不会改变临界安全设计。日本核燃料解释，贫化铀中铀-235比例低于天然铀，相关变更属于贫化铀储存能力提升，不属于临界管理对象。公司计划于2026年7月提交经营变更许可申请，变更设施预计于2028年9月投入使用。

title: 标准核能两座TRISO燃料设施基本完工，年新增产能最高可达5公吨铀
content:
标准核能公司 (Standard Nuclear) 近日宣布，其两座即将投产的TRISO核燃料生产设施在建设和监管审批方面取得进展。公司称，新建的SN-TN和SN-ID两座设施已基本完工，全面投产后合计每年可新增最高5公吨铀的TRISO燃料产能，初期预计每座设施每年可新增最高1公吨铀产能。
标准核能表示，两座设施的启动、调试和许可工作将在今年夏季继续推进。与此同时，公司已获得美国能源部 (DOE) 对两座设施初步文件化安全分析 (PDSA) 的批准。待美国能源部完成全面授权后，相关燃料生产线将作为二级危险等级 (HC-2) 核设施运行。
目前，标准核能在田纳西州橡树岭运营SN-0设施，该设施已具备TRISO燃料生产能力，年产能最高为0.5公吨铀。公司称，新设施建设能够较快推进，主要得益于可重复的设施设计、供应商协同以及模块化生产线复制等措施，这些做法有助于降低首批建设平台的设计不确定性。
标准核能首席执行官科特·特拉尼 (Kurt Terrani) 表示，公司正在通过成熟的模块化制造框架部署更多生产线，以满足先进核燃料需求增长。该框架可复制安全可靠的系统，从而支持快速扩产、缩短投产周期，并控制资本投入。公司还表示，爱达荷国家实验室提供的专家支持和技术援助，帮助其推进美国能源部核设施许可流程。
除田纳西州和爱达荷州项目外，标准核能还在华盛顿州推进另一条燃料生产线建设。该项目是其与法马通公司 (Framatome, Inc.) 合资项目的一部分，并利用法马通现有的美国核管理委员会 (NRC) 许可证。
TRISO燃料是一类高性能包覆颗粒燃料，被用于多种先进反应堆设计。美国核管理委员会将其称为“功能性安全壳”，原因在于其燃料颗粒结构可在反应堆堆芯中承担重要安全功能。
标准核能称，随着田纳西州和爱达荷州设施建设基本完成，公司下一阶段工作将集中在最终调试、完成监管审批以及按客户需求和时间表启动生产。该公司定位为独立TRISO燃料制造商，业务还涵盖先进核燃料和放射性同位素动力系统生产。

title: 罗马尼亚SMR项目战略重评提案未获股东批准
content:
罗马尼亚国家核电公司 (Nuclearelectrica，SNN) 近日表示，公司提出的“小型模块化反应堆初始发展战略重新评估”相关议案未获股东批准。该议案原拟启动技术基准研究，将分析范围扩大至其他小型模块化反应堆技术，并在必要时扩大潜在厂址选择范围。
NuScale小型模块化反应堆(SMR)工厂的可能外观(图片：NuScale)
SNN在声明中称，围绕多伊切什蒂(Doicești)项目作出最终投资决定所需满足的若干条件，因公司及项目公司罗电核能公司 (RoPower Nuclear SA) 无法控制的原因未能达成。公司原希望通过相关研究和多方案分析，结合最新技术进展，为罗马尼亚后续决策提供依据，寻找更有利的实施方案。
由于包括大股东罗马尼亚能源部在内的股东投票反对该议案，SNN表示，将按照股东今年2月批准的方向，继续与努斯凯尔电力公司 (NuScale Power) 就小型模块化反应堆模块采购条款及框架协议寻求商业共识，同时与罗马尼亚政府代表讨论其他条件的落实可行性。其中部分条件由控股股东能源部提出。
今年2月，SNN股东已就采用NuScale技术的SMR项目作出最终投资决定。项目计划在布加勒斯特西北约90公里的多伊切什蒂原燃煤电厂旧址建设6个模块，总装机容量462兆瓦，单个模块装机容量77兆瓦。
SNN在7月15日会议当天发布的声明中说，公司正继续与能源部就最终投资决定及财政支持相关条件进行磋商。声明同时指出，作为首创项目，该项目在技术、运营和财务层面的复杂性通常高于后续复制项目。
罗马尼亚能源部长克里斯蒂安·布索伊 (Cristian Bușoi) 次日表示，提交审议的内容并非对小型模块化反应堆项目实际战略或实施战略的具体更新，而只是启动评估更新可能性的步骤。能源部认为，由于缺乏充分的数据、分析和论证，该请求并不充分。布索伊还称，公司执行管理层有责任准备、论证并启动此类方案，并采取必要措施评估情况，维护公司和股东利益。
布索伊同时表示，作为负责国际关系和核能项目实施的国务卿，他与SNN管理层及美国合作方保持持续沟通，并定期同美国能源部相关团队举行视频会议，以评估继续推进SMR项目的合适方案，其中也包括研究采用其他美国SMR技术的可能性。
NuScale Power表示，将继续与SNN和RoPower合作，以满足股东批准财务投资决定时所附加的条件。
罗马尼亚与美国在SMR领域的合作始于2019年3月。当时，SNN与NuScale Power签署谅解备忘录，研究潜在开发项目。2021年，双方签署合作协议，计划在本十年末前于罗马尼亚部署一座NuScale VOYGR-6小型模块化反应堆电站。2022年6月，双方再次签署谅解备忘录，启动项目工程研究、技术审查和许可审批等工作。
2023年底，NuScale Power与RoPower完成了前端工程设计(FEED)第一阶段研究，对首座VOYGR-6小型模块化反应堆电站的首选厂址进行了分析。FEED第二阶段研究也已完成，福陆公司 (Fluor Corporation) 为RoPower提供了项目实施所需的设计和工程服务，包括更新后的成本估算、进度计划以及最终投资决定所需的安全分析。
美国进出口银行 (Exim Bank) 于2024年批准一笔9800万美元贷款，用于项目前期服务。美国国际发展金融公司 (DFC) 和美国进出口银行还分别签发意向书，表示可能为项目部署提供最高10亿美元和30亿美元支持。

title: 美国能源部拟向Radiant分配第二批HALEU燃料
content:
美国先进核技术企业Radiant7月23日宣布，美国能源部 (DOE) 已初步选定该公司获得第二批高丰度低浓缩铀 (HALEU) 分配。这批核燃料将用于其计划在科罗拉多州奥罗拉市巴克利太空军基地建设的微型反应堆项目，目标交付时间为2028年。
Radiant称，该项目将为美国军事设施中首个商业微型反应堆提供燃料保障。该公司正在开发名为Kaleidos的便携式微型反应堆，单机功率为1兆瓦，面向商业、政府和国防客户提供电力。
在美国能源部第三轮HALEU分配中，Radiant是唯一入选的私营部门机构。同期入选的还包括美国国家航空航天局 (NASA)，其分配燃料将用于SR-1 Freedom火星任务。
Radiant首席核能官丽塔·巴兰瓦尔 (Rita Baranwal) 表示，此次燃料分配使巴克利太空军基地对韧性电力的需求更接近实际运行目标。她称，部分关键任务需要在电网中断、燃料供应紧张或常规基础设施受限的情况下保持连续供电，美国能源部正在帮助公司建立相应燃料供应渠道。
今年4月，美国空军部 (Department of the Air Force) 和国防创新单元 (Defense Innovation Unit) 选择Radiant在巴克利太空军基地开发并运行一座微型反应堆，该项目隶属于“设施先进核电计划”(Advanced Nuclear Power for Installations)。根据计划，首批Kaleidos反应堆将于2028年交付，用于为基地提供持续电力支持。
美国能源部核能助理部长泰德·加里什 (Ted Garrish) 表示，燃料分配体现了先进核反应堆燃料供应对太空探索和国家安全任务的重要性。美国能源部正在通过HALEU可用性计划推动国内核燃料供应体系建设，以支持先进核能项目发展。
此前，美国能源部已选定向Radiant在爱达荷国家实验室进行的Kaleidos开发装置测试提供HALEU资源。Radiant表示，两项燃料分配将共同支持其推进便携式微型反应堆商业化和工程交付。

title: 萨金特-伦迪与Curio推进NuCycle核燃料回收技术商业化部署
content:
7月23日，萨金特-伦迪公司 (Sargent & Lundy) 与Curio公司 (Curio) 推进NuCycle先进核燃料循环技术商业部署，相关工作已进入工程实施阶段。
Curio已验证其NuCycle技术的科学可行性，下一步将面向工业规模应用推进商业化部署。该技术旨在通过回收利用乏核燃料，减少剩余高放射性物质的数量，从而支持更加可持续的核燃料循环。
根据项目安排，萨金特-伦迪将为Curio提供选址、环境支持、许可审批支持以及设施设计开发等服务。相关工作包括NuCycle工艺大楼及配套基础设施的概念设计。
萨金特-伦迪拥有70余年商业核电领域经验。其工程与设计工作将帮助Curio把专有工艺转化为一体化设施方案，使该设施具备安全运行、维护便利和规模化扩展能力，并为未来申请美国核管理委员会 (NRC) 许可提供支撑。

title: 阿根廷核电公司将为罗马尼亚CANDU机组延寿提供技术支持
content:
阿根廷核电公司 (Nucleoeléctrica Argentina S.A., NASA) 与罗马尼亚核电公司 (Nuclearelectrica) 签署谅解备忘录，双方将围绕罗马尼亚切尔纳沃德核电站CANDU反应堆延寿项目开展合作，阿方将提供工程和技术援助服务。
切尔纳沃德核电站采用CANDU重水堆技术，与阿根廷科尔多瓦省恩巴尔塞核电站使用的技术路线相同。阿根廷核电公司表示，这一技术共性使其在恩巴尔塞核电站延寿项目中积累的经验，可用于支持其他同类型机组的运行寿命管理和改造工作。
恩巴尔塞核电站延寿项目于2019年完成，是阿根廷核能领域复杂度较高的工程之一。该项目将机组运行寿命延长30年，并主要依托阿根廷本土资源、工程能力和专业人员实施。相关经验随后被用于阿图查一号核电机组现代化和延寿工作，包括项目规划、工程设计和施工管理等方面。
近年来，阿根廷核电公司已多次参与国际核能合作。该公司曾与坎杜能源公司 (Candu Energy Inc.) 合作销售CANDU反应堆部件，为中国秦山核电站反应堆换管工程提供技术支持，并基于恩巴尔塞核电站现代化改造经验，为韩国核能专业人员开展培训。
阿根廷核电公司称，此次备忘录是其推动核能服务出口业务的一部分，重点包括向采用类似技术的核电站提供工程服务、技术援助以及在阿根廷形成的技术解决方案。
在全球电力需求增长、核能作为低碳基荷电源重新受到关注的背景下，多国正推进既有核电机组延寿和相关核能项目。阿根廷核电公司希望依托阿图查一号、阿图查二号和恩巴尔塞核电站的运行及改造经验，扩大其在国际核能专业服务市场中的参与度。

title: 阿达尼电力称核电布局需等待印度私营准入规则落地
content:
印度阿达尼电力公司 (Adani Power) 高管在7月23日举行的财报电话会议上表示，公司开发核电项目的计划，将取决于印度政府最终确定允许私营部门参与核电行业的相关规则。
阿达尼电力此前提出，到2035年形成10吉瓦核电装机容量的目标。公司称，目前正在评估印度国内及海外反应堆技术，但在监管框架明确之前，尚无法作出最终投资决定。
阿达尼电力首席执行官谢尔辛格·卡亚利亚 (Shersingh Khyalia) 表示，项目推进取决于不同方案的成本竞争力。他说，电力价格必须对印度消费者具有可接受性，同时也要处于电力分销公司能够承受的范围内。
公司方面表示，正在评估印度中部中央邦比纳、尼格里等地点的适宜性，认为这些地点未来具备发展核能项目的潜力。相关研究仍在进行，公司希望提前做好潜在厂址准备，以便在法规出台后及时推进后续工作。
印度正推动扩大清洁能源利用，并已在去年向国内外私营企业开放核电行业。按照印度方面设定的目标，到2047年，该国核电装机容量将从目前约8.8吉瓦增至100吉瓦。
目前，印度核电有限公司 (NPCIL) 是印度唯一的核电站运营商，其目标是形成50吉瓦核电装机容量。印度国家火电公司 (NTPC) 作为该国最大的燃煤电厂运营商，也提出了30吉瓦核电装机目标。除阿达尼电力外，塔塔电力公司 (Tata Power) 和信实工业公司 (Reliance Industries) 等私营企业也在评估进入印度核电领域的可能性。

title: 核工业首个控制大区全国产化工业互联网平台落地应用--中国能源新闻网
content:
核工业首个控制大区全国产化工业互联网平台落地应用--中国能源新闻网
中电传媒股份有限公司主办
核工业首个控制大区全国产化工业互联网平台落地应用
近日，由中核集团核动力院下属中核控制自主研发的龙赑®全国产化工业互联网平台成功落地应用，为我国核工业数字化转型提供了坚实“底座”。作为我国首个面向核工业高安全场景打造的国产化工业互联网平台，龙赑®实现了从底层芯片、操作系统、数据库到上层工业应用的100%国产化，突破了制约我国核工业数字化、智能化发展的关键瓶颈，补齐了保障国家能源安全的关键技术短板。
工业互联网平台是核工业数字化转型的“神经中枢”。龙赑®平台采用平台+工业APP的开放架构，深度融合云计算、大数据、人工智能等新一代信息技术，可与我国自主研发的龙鳍®、龙核®DCS系统实现原生无缝对接，同时兼容全品类工业设备与传感器，具备全链路数据采集、实时分析、智能决策、安全防护一体化能力，可覆盖核电、核燃料、核化工、核技术应用等核工业全产业链场景，支撑核设施向少人值守、智能运行升级。
